briefs.title: July 14, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week in digital transformation highlights innovative advancements and pressing challenges in technology. Rakuten&#039;s edge computing innovations promise to enhance IoT capabilities, while cybersecurity concerns regard...
briefs.content:
Edge Computing

Japanese giant Rakuten Inc. has unveiled its next-generation Edge Computing base station. This station, powered by the combined force of 5G and AI technology, is set to revolutionize IoT applications. The use of 5 G ensures high-speed data transfer, while AI enhances the station's processing power. This milestone is critical for Rakuten's business ecosystem, demonstrating a significant advance in fostering IoT and digital innovation. With unrivaled speed and processing power, this new tool could revolutionize the IoT industry, offering greater efficiency and connectivity for devices and applications. Read More

<hr>

Industry executives are raising the alarm about the growing risk of botnet infections precipitated by vulnerabilities in Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Many of these devices remain insecure and poorly protected, making them prime targets for cyber threats. These circumstances showcase a glaring need for immediate and all-encompassing cybersecurity measures. Vigorous and efficient security protocols must be implemented without delay to curtail the persistent danger from botnets and provide a safe digital environment. Read More

<hr>

Pusan National University has developed a proposal for backscatter communications within low-power Internet of Things (IoT) devices. This innovative idea offers a potential solution to power management issues facing the rapidly growing edge-computing environment. If successful, the proposed backscatter communication system would significantly reduce the energy consumption of IoT devices, making them more sustainable and efficient. This reduction in energy consumption could lead to longer battery life and less frequent recharging, a critical improvement needed in this era of advanced technology and increased connectivity. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

Various global cybersecurity agencies are issuing alarming warnings about a heightened cyber threat from China. These agencies caution organizations to bolster their defense systems against potential cyberattacks. This rise in cyber threats emphasizes the growing need for rigorous cybersecurity measures. Threatening activities reportedly include data theft, ransomware attacks, and corporate espionage, underscoring the urgency for organizations to protect their digital infrastructures promptly and efficiently. Read More

<hr>

As the Paris Olympics approach, cybersecurity experts are bracing for potential difficulties. They anticipate substantial hurdles in safeguarding the event's digital infrastructure from possible threats. Many digital assets are vulnerable, from online ticketing systems to broadcasting networks and athletes' data. Cybercriminals could exploit weaknesses in the digital framework, causing disruption, misinformation, or theft. The need for robust cybersecurity measures is critical to maintaining the smooth flow of the event. Read More

<hr>

AT&T recently experienced a cyberattack, resulting in a significant data breach. In this breach, customers' call logs were compromised, highlighting the persisting issues surrounding network cybersecurity. This situation underscores the need for stronger cybersecurity measures in leading telecom companies. In this era where data is gold, such security misdemeanors expose customers to potential breaches of privacy and identity theft. It further underscores the need for stronger cybersecurity measures to protect users' sensitive data. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

OpenAI and tech giant Microsoft have embarked on a promising collaboration that could redefine AI research and optimize the GPT platform. The core objective of this partnership is to investigate and develop safe and potentially beneficial applications of artificial intelligence in line with global demands. The alliance anticipates significantly influencing AI's transformative role in society by prioritizing safety and the broad implications of artificial general intelligence. Read More

<hr>

A recent study has raised alarm over the significant amounts of electricity Artificial Intelligence consumes, which is adding strain to the power grid. This environmental impact worries experts, who are now calling for a shift towards more sustainable practices in AI development. They emphasize that the field needs to focus on reducing energy consumption to address rising environmental concerns, demonstrating a more significant commitment to sustainability to reduce its carbon footprint. Read More

<hr>

The Department of Justice recently convened an interagency conference on promoting equality in the utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Participants engaged in detailed discussions about AI deployment strategies and crucial measures needed to reduce bias in AI systems and ensure their fair and unbiased usage. The gathering emphasized the importance of implementing AI technologies in a manner that upholds principles of equality and fairness across different sectors. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

Embracing Digital's latest podcast explores the nuances of managing cultural shifts in a digital-first environment. Highlights include strategies for successful digital transformation and challenges faced in the process. Tune in to Episode 209 now. Read More

briefs.title: July 07, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week focuses on critical advancements in digital transformation as of July 7, 2024, highlighting developments in Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, and Data Management. Understanding the integration of AI into public s...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

Artificial Intelligence (AI) stands at the precipice of transforming public services in sectors ranging from healthcare to transportation. Notably, the deployment of AI could simplify complex processes, enhance decision-making accuracy, and aid effective resource allocation, thus maximizing efficiency. The integration of AI into these core public services holds the promise of significant societal benefits, including improved service delivery, reduced operational costs, and better patient care outcomes, thereby greatly contributing to the quality of life for the general public. Read More

<hr>

China's recent overthrow of the US in the AI patent race is a clear sign of its growing dominance in the AI field. This has triggered an increased strategic competition between these global economic giants, pushing the boundaries of technological advancements further. The impact is significant as it paves the way for a revolution in the tech industry, setting new standards and redefining existing paradigms in AI development and technology at large. Read More

<hr>

Despite promises of a rapid AI revolution, slower progress in artificial intelligence technology has sparked concern and skepticism among many. Critics believe that the delays could point to a larger issue, questioning the reliability and efficiency of current AI systems. However, AI advocates argue that these slow advances are merely the calm before the storm. They believe these issues are only temporary setbacks, predicting that once resolved, AI technology will explode in growth, transforming our digital landscape beyond our imagination. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

In an unprecedented global cybersecurity collaborative effort, a VPN service used by cybercriminals to execute attacks has been successfully disabled. The VPN enabled criminals to remain anonymous as they launched online attacks across the world. The mass shutdown, which is considered a significant achievement in combating cybercrime, witnessed the decommissioning of over 600 servers. This operation exemplifies global cooperation in the fight against increasing internet malevolence. Read More

<hr>

The France-based cloud provider, OVHcloud, faces a record fine of $840 million due to a cybersecurity breach. This enormous sanction comes as a stark reminder of the escalating economic consequences of inadequate cybersecurity safeguards. The severity of this penalty reflects how paramount effective cybersecurity systems are in the digital age. The OVHcloud case serves as a stern warning to other companies about the importance of investing in robust cybersecurity infrastructures. Read More

<hr>

ZOTAC, a global manufacturer of graphics cards, mini PCs, and other computing hardware, has suffered a significant data leak impacting numerous customer RMA documents due to a server misconfiguration error. These exposed documents held valuable customer information, highlighting the crucial importance of stringent server security configurations and effective data management strategies. In this digital age, incidents like these serve as potent reminders for companies to prioritize the protection of customer data to maintain trust and credibility. Read More

<hr>

Data Management

Denodo Technologies has unveiled the updated version of its flagship solution, Denodo Platform 9.0. The new release incorporates artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities in its API, enhancing intelligent data management. The AI-powered system significantly simplifies procedures such as data cataloguing and preparation. This advancement represents a notable progression in the realm of data management solutions, providing efficiency and accuracy in various data-related tasks. Read More

<hr>

Generative AI, an innovative technology that employs complex algorithms to create and forecast data trends, is poised to radically transform the data management landscape. This technology is not just about data organization; it's also about leveraging critical insights to enhance decision-making abilities. Businesses stand to gain substantially from adopting this technology as it turns data into actionable intelligence, thus enabling smarter, data-driven decisions that can propel growth and success. Read More

<hr>

Blockchain startup SendBlocks recently raised $8.2 million in funding to boost its blockchain-based data management innovation. The platform empowers users to record, manage, and track digital assets, providing a transparent and legitimate medium for transactions. This significant financial backing will further enable SendBlocks to redefine secure and efficient digital asset management. It aligns with the growing trend towards tech innovations ensuring integrity and transparency in digital asset ownership. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

The latest "Embracing Digital Transformation" podcast features Rob Atkinson discussing the future of digital policy. Key topics include the integration of traditional and digital workforces to enhance productivity, debunking myths about digital innovation from his best-selling book, and strategies for informed decision-making in the digital age. This episode offers valuable insights for business leaders and tech enthusiasts. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: July 01, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week highlights developments in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity, with a focus on impactful industry discussions. The U.S. Department of Defense&#039;s efforts to simplify technology adoption ...
briefs.content:
Ubiquitous Computing

SAP, Oracle, and IBM have achieved record valuations driven by cloud and AI technologies. These legacy software giants are not just adapting, but strategically transforming to stay competitive, leveraging advanced innovations to boost growth and profitability. Their foresight in this transformation highlights the critical role of evolving tech in the industry and reassures us about their future. Read More

<hr>

The Pentagon's Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) is at the forefront of accelerating the adoption of commercial technology to solve national security challenges. Its recent approval of new supercomputer cloud services is a testament to this commitment. The move aims to leverage commercial cloud technologies for advanced computing needs, supporting various defense operations and research initiatives across the Department of Defense. Read More

<hr>

Alibaba Cloud has replaced Nvidia's interconnect with its Ethernet-based High-Performance Network (HPN) to connect 15,000 GPUs in its data centers. As detailed by engineer Ennan Zhai, this new system enhances data flow for ample language model training, reducing failures and improving efficiency with a dual-plane architecture and custom vapor chamber heat sinks. This shift aims to lower costs and avoid reliance on Nvidia technology. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

FedRAMP has introduced a fast-pass approval process for AI tools, expediting the deployment of artificial intelligence technologies in federal agencies. This initiative aims to streamline the integration of innovative AI solutions while maintaining rigorous security standards, enhancing efficiency, and promoting technological advancements in government operations. Read More

<hr>

Many are concerned about data privacy as AI development continues—Mustafa Suleyman of Microsoft advocates for free AI systems to promote transparency and innovation. Meanwhile, Perplexity AI faces criticism for alleged plagiarism and misinformation, emphasizing the need for ethical standards and accountability in AI development. Read More

<hr>

MIT robotics pioneer Rodney Brooks argues that generative AI, while impressive, needs to be more accurately estimated. He emphasizes that the technology, while not yet human-like, has immense potential. This emphasis on the potential of Generative AI can inspire us about its future possibilities and impact on society. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

A high-severity prompt injection flaw in the Vanna.AI library tracked as CVE-2024-5565, exposes databases to remote code execution (RCE) attacks. This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands via the "ask" function, potentially leading to significant security breaches. Vanna has issued a hardening guide advising users to run the library in a sandboxed environment to mitigate risks. This highlights the dangers of the widespread use of generative AI without proper governance and security measures. Read More

<hr>

Microsoft has disclosed a new cybersecurity threat, ' Skeleton Key AI Jailbreak,' capable of bypassing authentication systems. This technique could allow attackers to gain unauthorized access to networks, posing significant risks to cybersecurity. The disclosure aims to raise awareness and prompt mitigation efforts among organizations worldwide. Read More

<hr>

Security researchers have identified a new supply chain attack dubbed 'Polyfill.' This attack method infects third-party website libraries, potentially compromising visitor data. The Polyfill attack underscores the importance of vetting third-party software for vulnerabilities, making us more cautious about potential security risks. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, Darren discusses investing in Generative AI with Jiri Fiala, a VC and managing director of Indigilabs. Where is the money to be made in Generative AI? Is a Dotcom bubble on the way, and what does the future hold? Check out this interview! Also, ED-T the fish has a new friend: our Digital Transformation Snail, Gen-AI, pronounced Jenai. Read More

briefs.title: June 23, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore significant advancements in digital technology, featuring topics such as ubiquitous computing, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence. Understanding these advancements is crucial for organizations as th...
briefs.content:
Ubiquitous Computing

The U.S. Navy is taking a proactive stance in advancing its IT capabilities by integrating cloud computing on its ships. This promising move is set to enhance operational efficiency and data management, while also bolstering cybersecurity and facilitating rapid software updates. The Navy's shift to cloud services is a testament to its commitment to managing and processing vast amounts of data more effectively, a crucial aspect for missions and fleet management across global operations. Read More

<hr>

Cohesity and Intel are joining forces in a significant partnership to enhance the FortKnox cloud service with confidential computing. This collaboration, which integrates Intel's Software Guard Extensions (SGX) to secure data during processing, is a major step towards protecting sensitive information from breaches and insider threats. The enhanced security measures are set to make cloud services more viable for industries handling regulated data, instilling confidence in the future of cloud computing solutions. Read More

<hr>

Oracle is making a significant commitment to Spain's digital transformation efforts by planning to invest over $1 billion in AI and cloud computing over the next decade. This substantial investment includes the establishment of a new cloud region to assist customers in migrating workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure while complying with EU regulations. The initiative, which will be Oracle's third cloud region in Madrid in partnership with Telefonica España, is set to play a pivotal role in supporting Spanish businesses and public sector organizations. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

Organizations are being held criminally liable for lack of cybersecurity. Sellafield, a primary UK nuclear processing site, has pleaded guilty to criminal charges over cybersecurity failings. The Office for Nuclear Regulation found that Sellafield violated the Nuclear Industries Security Regulations between 2019 and early 2023. While there was no immediate threat to public safety, the site has faced repeated cybersecurity issues and will now undergo legal proceedings to address these violations. Read More

<hr>

Despite widespread use, multi-factor authentication (MFA) is no longer sufficient to protect cloud data. Attackers have found ways to bypass MFA through phishing and social engineering attacks, highlighting the need for additional security measures. One such measure is implementing a Zero Trust Architecture, a security model that requires strict identity verification for every user and device trying to access resources on a network, providing a more comprehensive defense by requiring multiple layers of authentication and continuous trust assessments. Read More

<hr>

AMD is investigating claims of a data breach after a hacker offered to sell sensitive information allegedly stolen from the company. The hacker, IntelBroker, posted on a cybercrime forum that the stolen data includes details on future AMD products, customer and employee information, datasheets, source code, firmware, and financial documents. AMD collaborates with law enforcement and third-party experts to verify the breach and assess the potential impact. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

The rapid adoption of generative AI (GenAI) is increasing insider threat risks and expanding the attack surface for businesses. Tools like ChatGPT and deep fake technology can unintentionally expose sensitive data if not properly managed. This necessitates stricter security measures and policies to counter "Shadow AI," where AI tools are used outside organizational governance. Companies must secure AI software supply chains and balance innovation with robust cybersecurity practices to mitigate these emerging threats. Read More

<hr>

Anthropic has introduced its latest and most potent generative AI model, prompting significant interest and speculation. The model's capabilities and potential impacts on various sectors, including technology and society, are under scrutiny. This launch marks a milestone in AI development, raising questions about ethical implications and regulatory considerations—anthropic aims to advance AI responsibly while maximizing its benefits. Read More

<hr>

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has prioritized AI threats to critical infrastructure in new guidance. Emphasizing the vulnerabilities posed by AI, DHS aims to bolster defenses against cyber risks. This initiative underscores the growing intersection of AI and national security concerns. The guidance outlines strategies to enhance resilience and mitigate potential impacts on vital sectors. DHS urges proactive measures amid increasing reliance on AI across infrastructure, highlighting ongoing efforts to safeguard against emerging threats. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, in a solo act, Darren launches into a monologue on the importance of Enterprise Architecture to help organizations manage the complex operating environments in which they live. Thanks again to my listeners; we continue to break new weekly listening numbers. Keep listening and share with your friends. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: June 16, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week’s digital transformation highlights focus on artificial intelligence, data management, and cybersecurity developments. Key discussions include the Pope&#039;s insights on AI ethics, advancements in AI data manageme...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

Researchers have recently unearthed a concerning exploit, dubbed the 'Sleepy Pickle', that poses a significant threat to the security of machine learning (ML) models. This exploit, which injects malicious code during packaging, targets the integrity of ML models, leading them to perform unintended actions. By exploiting vulnerabilities in the pickle serialization format, attackers can manipulate models without detection, thereby jeopardizing the reliability of AI-driven applications. Read More

<hr>

Remember: AI has made serious errors, from chatbots giving lousy advice to facial recognition falsely identifying people. Examples include Air Canada's chatbot causing legal problems and Microsoft's Tay posting inappropriate tweets. Amazon's AI showed bias against women, and medical chatbots have given harmful advice. AI recruitment tools have been discriminatory, and deepfake scams have caused financial losses. These incidents highlight the need for careful AI oversight. Read More

<hr>

Pope Francis highlighted the importance of maintaining human dignity in developing and using artificial intelligence (AI) during the G7 summit. He warned against reducing human relations to algorithms and urged politicians to keep AI human-centric. He also called for a ban on lethal autonomous weapons and emphasized the ethical risks of AI lacking human values. The G7 leaders' final statement reflected these concerns, committing to better governance of AI to protect human dignity and address potential impacts. Read More

<hr>

Data Management

Meta, in a significant move, has halted its AI training using European user data at the behest of the Irish Data Protection Commission. The company's plan to utilize public content from Facebook and Instagram without explicit user consent, citing 'Legitimate Interests', has been put on hold. This pause has a profound impact on Meta's AI development in Europe, where the stringent General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is in effect. Meta is committed to complying with European laws while addressing the privacy concerns raised by regulators and advocacy groups. Read More

<hr>

Vermont Governor Phil Scott vetoed a robust data privacy bill, citing concerns it would make the state overly hostile to businesses. The bill, designed to restrict the sale of sensitive data and allow consumers to sue for privacy breaches, was deemed potentially harmful to mid-sized and small businesses. The Democrat-controlled Legislature plans to override the veto in a special session. Read More

<hr>

In an interesting co-dependent relationship, AI is transforming data management by enhancing efficiency and decision-making processes. Organizations are leveraging AI to handle large volumes of data and generate actionable insights. Does this mean AI will begin to expand its knowledge by managing and discovering data on its own? This is something we should be watching with a cautious eye. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

A UK hacker associated with the notorious Scattered Spider group has been apprehended. The group, known for high-profile cyber attacks, poses significant security risks. Authorities emphasize the hacker's capture as a major victory in cybercrime prevention. This incident underscores the ongoing threat of cybercriminal activities and the importance of enhanced cybersecurity measures. Read More

<hr>

With escalating cyber threats, industries like finance, healthcare, and government are adopting military-grade cyber defenses. Under stringent regulatory pressures, these sectors seek robust cybersecurity measures to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance. Military technologies such as real-time analytics, machine learning, and threat intelligence are increasingly used to preempt and neutralize attacks. Collaboration with defense agencies enhances these efforts, aiming to safeguard critical infrastructure against external and insider threats. Read More

<hr>

Cyberwar spreads beyond the primary players! Security researchers from Cisco Talos and Volexity have uncovered two separate espionage campaigns by Pakistani threat actors targeting Indian government entities. The campaigns, identified as "Operation Celestial Force" and involving malware such as GravityRAT and Disgomoji, aim at the defense and government sectors. The attackers use spear phishing and social engineering tactics to infiltrate systems. This activity highlights ongoing cybersecurity tensions between the neighboring countries. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, Darren continues his interview with Steve Orrin on securing Generative AI in the enterprise and how Generative AI is starting to fight our cyber battles for us. On a side note, many have asked if ED-T, the newscast's mascot, is real. He absolutely is. He was a Christmas gift from Darren's kids and has turned into a common fixture on the newscast. You can check out his fish cam on our YouTube site. Read More

<hr>

briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, significant developments emerged in the Digital Transformation landscape, particularly in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and data management. Intel&#039;s introduction of the Gaudi 3 AI chip signifies a c...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

SAP has unveiled a groundbreaking integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into its product suite, a move set to revolutionize business processes across industries. This pioneering strategy includes AI-powered tools for supply chain optimization, finance automation, and human resources. SAP's cutting-edge AI capabilities are poised to boost efficiency, slash costs, and empower enterprises to make smarter decisions. The company's use of partnerships and in-house innovations to deliver these advanced solutions marks a significant shift in technological strategy, promising a future of unprecedented possibilities. Read More

<hr>

Apple's latest innovation, 'Apple Intelligence', is a user-centric AI system integrated into iPhone, iPad, and Mac operating systems. This initiative, unveiled at the WWDC, is designed to elevate user experiences through AI-powered features and a ChatGPT-like chatbot. Apple's plan includes the release of new software for Vision Pro, Apple Watch, and TV platforms, with the AI capabilities being optional and available on newer device models. The company's focus on highlighting security measures for AI data processing addresses privacy concerns, ensuring a safe and enhanced user experience. Read More

<hr>

Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger has made a bold move in response to Nvidia's dominance in AI chips, underlining Intel's strategic advancements and investments in AI technology. Gelsinger has spotlighted Intel's upcoming chips, which are poised to compete with Nvidia's GPUs and reclaim leadership in the AI market. Intel's efforts, including innovations in chip architecture and partnerships with key AI developers, demonstrate the company's unwavering commitment to challenging Nvidia's current market position and advancing AI capabilities. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

Microsoft had reversed a significant cybersecurity decision widely criticized as the "dumbest" move in the past decade. The rollback follows backlash from security experts and users who highlighted the increased vulnerability it caused. The specific changes involved default settings that weakened security postures. Microsoft acknowledged the error and reinstated stronger protections, reaffirming its commitment to user security and privacy. Read More

<hr>

Trend Micro and Intel have partnered to develop new AI-powered security solutions. This collaboration aims to enhance cybersecurity by integrating advanced AI technologies into Trend Micro's security products, leveraging Intel's hardware capabilities. The goal is to improve threat detection and response times, providing more robust protection against emerging cyber threats. This partnership underscores the growing importance of AI in the cybersecurity landscape. Read More

<hr>

Researchers at Texas A&M University and Ho Technical University have developed a new ransomware attack method called Evolutional Generative Adversarial Network (EGAN). This approach uses advanced AI to create ransomware capable of evading many commercial antivirus systems. By combining evolution strategies and GANs, the ransomware can mutate and appear benign, making detection challenging. The findings highlight the need for more robust cybersecurity measures to counter these sophisticated threats. Read More

<hr>

Data Management

Recent research from Harvard Business Review shows that IT leaders should consider adopting a franchise model for data management to enhance consistency, scalability, and efficiency across their organizations. This approach involves creating standardized data practices and tools that can be replicated across various departments or units, similar to how a franchise operates. By doing so, organizations can ensure better data governance, reduce redundancy, and improve overall data quality, leading to more informed decision-making and operational excellence. Read More

<hr>

Databricks has announced its acquisition of the data management startup Tabular. This strategic move aims to enhance Databricks' data management and analytics capabilities, integrating Tabular's innovative technologies into its existing platform. The acquisition is expected to bolster Databricks' position in the data analytics market by providing users with more advanced and comprehensive solutions. This development signifies a growing trend of consolidation in the data management sector. Read More

<hr>

Leveraging blockchain for document management enhances security and compliance by providing a tamper-proof and transparent system. Blockchain ensures document integrity, improves audit trails, and facilitates secure stakeholder sharing. This technology benefits industries with stringent regulatory requirements, as it automates compliance processes and reduces the risk of data breaches. By integrating blockchain, organizations can streamline document workflows and ensure reliable record-keeping. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week on Embracing Digital Transformation, Darren continues with another interview with Intel Federal's CTO, Steve Orrin. They talk about Securing AI/ML Ops and the trustworthiness of AI Models in training and production. Read More

<hr>

briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance The week of June 2, 2024, highlights significant developments in digital transformation, particularly in edge computing, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. Understanding these trends is crucial as they shape executive d...
briefs.content:
Edge Computing

With Intel's recent announcement of a $20 billion investment in Silicon Manufacturing, the American heartland is poised to become a leader in autonomous technology. This significant investment will boost the local economies of regions like Ohio and Indiana and position them as pioneers in cutting-edge tech. The resulting advancements in agriculture and transportation are set to transform industries, enhance productivity, and create new job opportunities, driving the heartland's economic resurgence. Read More

<hr>

Seattle Mayor Bruce Harrell's decision to shelve plans for implementing ShotSpotter technology was made in collaboration with others. It was a response to the concerns raised by the community, including the Seattle City Council. The exclusion of the $1 million funding for ShotSpotter from the 2023-2024 budget indicates the community's voice is being heard. The decision was influenced by concerns over the technology's effectiveness and potential impact on police response times and the community's priorities for human services and support for the homeless. Read More

<hr>

San Diego County has launched Genasys EVAC technology, a system designed to enhance emergency evacuations. This innovative technology allows for more precise, location-based alerts using geo-boundaries to create detailed mapping zones. The goal is to limit unnecessary evacuations and facilitate quicker repopulations, thereby improving the efficiency and effectiveness of emergency response. The technology integrates with AlertSanDiego.org and the SD Emergency app, requiring no additional downloads for registered users. As fire season approaches, officials urge residents to stay informed and prepared, with the reassurance that this advanced technology is in place to protect them. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

In Q1 2024, GenAI-capable smartphones saw a significant rise in market share, increasing from 1.3% to 6%. The premium segment dominated, with Samsung's Galaxy S24 series securing the top three spots. Chinese brands, including Xiaomi and Vivo, also performed well, with six positions in the top ten. The GenAI features driving this growth include chat/note assist, which uses AI to enhance note-taking and messaging, and AI-generated portraits, which use AI algorithms to create realistic paintings. By the end of 2024, GenAI-capable smartphones are expected to account for 11% of the market. Read More

<hr>

British employees are rapidly adopting generative AI, a type of AI that can generate new content or data based on existing patterns, in the workplace, often without explicit business endorsement. This trend highlights a grassroots drive towards efficiency and innovation. Despite some businesses' reluctance, employees find GenAI tools beneficial for tasks such as data analysis, content creation, and customer service. As a result, companies are increasingly recognizing the need to integrate GenAI to stay competitive and fully harness its potential. Read More

<hr>

Business leaders are overlooking critical aspects of generative AI (GenAI). Despite its rapid adoption, leaders may need to recognize the technology's potential pitfalls, such as over-reliance and ethical concerns. Experts urge leaders to develop a deeper understanding of GenAI's limitations and to implement strategies that balance innovation with responsibility. Awareness and proactive measures can help organizations fully leverage GenAI's benefits while mitigating risks. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

AI company Hugging Face recently discovered unauthorized access to its Spaces platform. The breach may have exposed certain secrets, prompting the company to revoke affected HF tokens and notify users. Hugging Face advises users to refresh keys and switch to fine-grained access tokens. The incident, now under investigation, underscores cyber attackers' increasing targeting of AI-as-a-service platforms. Read More

<hr>

Microsoft has highlighted a rise in cyber attacks targeting internet-exposed operational technology (OT) devices, exploiting weak security measures to disrupt industrial processes. The company recommends enhancing security practices to protect OT environments, such as reducing the attack surface and adopting zero-trust principles. This surge in attacks underscores the need for robust security protocols to safeguard critical systems from becoming vulnerable to cyber threats. Read More

<hr>

A hacker has incapacitated 600,000 routers within 72 hours, rendering them inoperable. The attack exploited vulnerabilities in outdated firmware, causing widespread internet disruptions. As a result, affected users experienced a complete loss of internet connectivity, highlighting the potential impact of such cyber attacks on their daily lives. Experts emphasize the need for regular firmware updates and robust security measures to prevent such incidents. Affected users are urged to contact their internet service providers for support and to update their devices promptly to avoid further issues. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, Darren talks with recurring guest Steve Orrin, CTO of Intel Federal, about Securing Generative AI and AI in general. Generative AI has created new attack vectors that cyber advisories are exploiting. New cybersecurity best practices need to be established to handle this new paradigm. Check out this episode of the Embracing Digital Transformation podcast. Read More

<hr>

briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance In the week of May 26, 2024, significant advancements in digital transformation are highlighted, showcasing progress in high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. Intel&#039;s Aurora supercompute...
briefs.content:
Ubiquitous Computing

Intel's Aurora supercomputer, even in its construction phase, has shattered the exascale barrier, reaching a staggering 1.012 exaflops. This remarkable feat positions it as the second-fastest supercomputer worldwide, trailing only Oak Ridge's Frontier. Notably, Aurora also holds the title of the fastest AI system for open science, delivering a whopping 10.6 AI exaflops. The design of Aurora, which incorporates numerous Intel CPUs and GPUs, is geared toward propelling research in climate science, fusion energy, and other critical areas. Read More

<hr>

Despite the recent hype, cloud repatriation—moving workloads from the cloud back on-premises—remains minimal. Analysts suggest the trend is overblown, with most organizations maintaining or increasing their cloud investments due to flexibility, scalability, and innovation advantages. The cloud's role in modern IT strategies continues to grow, emphasizing its integral value despite some high-profile repatriation cases. Read More

<hr>

At the vanguard of quantum computing, researchers at the University of Basel have unveiled a revolutionary qubit technology utilizing hole spins. This breakthrough not only clears the path for practical quantum computers but also enables efficient and scalable qubit interactions on silicon chips. The team's mastery in controlling qubit interactions holds the promise of faster and more reliable quantum operations, heralding a significant leap towards large-scale quantum computing applications that could reshape our technological landscape. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

In a concerning development, cybersecurity experts have unearthed a flaw in Replicate's AI service. This vulnerability exposed customers' models and data to potential cross-tenant attacks, a serious security breach. The flaw, which involved arbitrary code execution via malicious models, was responsibly disclosed and patched. While there is no evidence of the flaw being exploited in the wild, this incident underscores the significant risks that AI-as-a-service providers need to address. Read More

<hr>

AI tutors are revolutionizing education in the U.S., with leading applications coming from China. These AI tools, such as those developed by companies like Khan Academy and Saga Education, offer personalized learning experiences, improve retention and understanding, and provide equal education opportunities by tailoring lessons to individual student needs. Despite challenges in building personal connections and handling complex subjects, AI tutors are becoming integral in classrooms, supplementing traditional teaching methods with adaptive learning and real-time feedback. Read More

<hr>

Google's AI efforts have faced criticism due to notable mistakes in search results and challenges in keeping pace with OpenAI. Despite substantial investments, Google's AI has struggled with accuracy and reliability, impacting user trust. The competition with OpenAI remains intense as both companies race to dominate the AI landscape. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

The recent discovery of a critical flaw in Replicate's AI service underscores the importance of securing AI infrastructures. This vulnerability exposed customer models and data to potential attacks, allowing unauthorized access through malicious models. The flaw was responsibly disclosed and patched, but the incident serves as a stark reminder of the risks associated with AI-as-a-service platforms. While there is no evidence of exploitation in the wild, the incident highlights the urgent need for robust cybersecurity measures to protect AI infrastructures. Read More

<hr>

France is leveraging AI-driven risk intelligence to enhance cybersecurity for the Paris 2024 Olympics. Blackbird.AI's Constellation platform identifies and analyzes online disinformation, assessing its risk and providing context to mitigate potential threats. The platform offers real-time monitoring of harmful narratives across various online platforms. This initiative, supported by French President Emmanuel Macron's establishment of Viginum in 2021, aims to counter digital foreign interference and protect the integrity of the Olympic Games. Read More

<hr>

The surge in cyber threats is a stark reminder of the urgent need to fortify our digital defenses. With cyberattacks occurring every 39 seconds, the stakes are high. New SEC rules mandate smaller firms to disclose breaches by June 15, while federal agencies must adopt zero-trust frameworks by Sept. 30. The real-world impact of attacks like the Colonial Pipeline shutdown in 2021 underscores the gravity of the situation. However, ensuring compliance and investing in cybersecurity are not just options but imperatives for future resilience in our increasingly digital world. Stay vigilant and informed for more updates and insights. Read More

This week, Darren interviewed the CEO and managing director of Zensar Technologies, Manish Tandon, about embracing digital transformation. They discussed the AI hype cycle and the importance of keeping humans in the loop and training people to become critical thinkers. Check out the latest at embracingdigital.org. Read More

briefs.title: May 19, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore significant developments in digital transformation, focusing on artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and edge computing. Understanding the latest cybersecurity threats and innovative techniques like jail...
briefs.content:
Edge Computing

Intel has launched a new Edge Platform to streamline the development and management of edge AI applications. The modular, open software platform supports enterprises in deploying and securing AI solutions efficiently, enhancing the total cost of ownership. Key features include simplified infrastructure management, advanced AI capabilities, and seamless integration with existing systems. The platform, backed by industry leaders like AWS, Lenovo, and SAP, addresses complexities in edge computing, ensuring optimal performance and security. Read More

<hr>

The World Economic Forum highlights the critical role of the Internet of Things (IoT) in modern supply chains, emphasizing how IoT devices enhance efficiency and resilience. Despite the rise of cloud computing, edge computing remains vital for real-time operations and security. Fusing AI with IoT (AIoT) drives innovation, promising a more connected and efficient future. This technology is crucial for managing vast amounts of data and improving operational responses in various industries​ Read More

<hr>

Edge computing offers significant benefits but comes with five major cybersecurity risks: IoT-specific vulnerabilities, an overwhelming amount of logs, data compromises, a broad attack surface, and budget limitations. Strategies to mitigate these risks include using authentication controls, automating log monitoring with AI, authenticating devices and users, encrypting network traffic, and deploying AI-driven intrusion detection systems. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

The US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has approved a voluntary cybersecurity labeling program for wireless consumer IoT products. The initiative aims to help consumers identify secure devices through a "US Cyber Trust Mark." This label, accompanied by a QR code with security details, incentivizes manufacturers to enhance cybersecurity standards. The program will involve public-private collaboration, with the FCC overseeing and third-party administrators managing the labeling process. The move addresses growing cybersecurity concerns as the number of IoT devices rises. Read More

<hr>

IBM's sudden exit from its cybersecurity software division has left many CISOs scrambling for alternatives. The unexpected move affects IBM's QRadar SaaS users, a leading security information and event management (SIEM) solution. Organizations must quickly transition to other providers, which could potentially lead to security gaps during the migration period. This highlights the critical need for contingency planning in cybersecurity strategies to ensure data protection during such transitions. Read More

<hr>

Cybercriminals are exploiting GitHub and FileZilla to spread malware, including stealer malware and banking trojans like Atomic, Vidar, and Lumma. They use fake profiles and repositories to distribute malicious software, targeting Android, macOS, and Windows platforms. The attack leverages legitimate services and involves sophisticated techniques such as SEO poisoning and malvertising. This highlights the growing misuse of trusted platforms for cyberattacks and underscores the need for heightened cybersecurity measures. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

The world addresses AI risks through various initiatives, including the AI Safety Summit in Korea, the EU's AI Act, the AI Pact, and international efforts by the OECD, G7, and the United Nations. These measures aim to regulate AI's impact on society, promote responsible innovation, and ensure human rights. Key developments include risk-based AI legislation, global safety commitments, and collaborative frameworks to manage AI's ethical and operational challenges. Read More

<hr>

The United States Department of Homeland Security has sounded the alarm on AI election threats, highlighting the potential risks of AI-generated disinformation, cyberattacks, and deepfake technology. This urgent call to action emphasizes the increasing vulnerability of elections and the need for bolstered cybersecurity measures. Launching public awareness campaigns is crucial to protect democratic processes, underscoring the immediate need to address AI's role in election security. Read More

<hr>

Researchers have raised concerns about the safety and robustness of Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Llama3, and Gemini. A study by researchers at AWS AI Labs has revealed vulnerabilities to adversarial attacks and jailbreaking, with successful attacks reaching 90% in the current models. They have proposed countermeasures that promise to reduce the success of such attacks. The models achieve top performance in spoken question-answering tasks, with safety and helpfulness metrics exceeding 80%. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

Darren is continuing his discussion with Robert Vaughn about how companies, both big and small, are using Intel's IT department to learn best practices and elevate the industry as a whole. Also, don't forget to share the Embracing Digital Transformation podcast with your colleagues. The weekly listenership is continuing to grow, with over 30,000 weekly listeners. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: May 12, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and data management, focusing on the latest developments and strategies employed by governments and industries. Understanding these converging fie...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

Last week cybersecurity experts converged on San Francisco for the RSA Conference. This year's conference spotlighted cybersecurity and AI innovations, stressing collaboration and innovation. Themes included AI's role in threat detection, zero-trust security models, and pop culture's influence on cybersecurity awareness. The surprise appearance of Ted Lasso added a unique touch, aiming to inspire fresh approaches to cyber threat mitigation. Read More

<hr>

Cybercriminals are leveraging GenAI technology, evolving their tactics to evade detection. Trend Micro's report highlights how criminals exploit AI-generated content for phishing and social engineering attacks. They create realistic personas and fake social media accounts, increasing the sophistication of their schemes. This trend underscores the need for robust cybersecurity measures and heightened awareness to combat emerging threats in the digital landscape. Read More

<hr>

As AI-driven deepfakes become more prevalent, cybersecurity faces a pressing challenge. Cybercriminals exploit this technology to create convincing yet fraudulent content for phishing and disinformation campaigns. With deepfakes rapidly advancing, security experts are in a race to develop countermeasures. Collaboration and innovation are crucial to stay ahead and protect against the escalating threat posed by AI-generated deception in the digital realm. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

Apple is finalizing a partnership with OpenAI to integrate ChatGPT into iPhones. This collaboration aims to enhance user experience by providing advanced conversational AI capabilities directly on Apple devices. By leveraging OpenAI's technology, Apple seeks to offer users intuitive and intelligent interactions, potentially revolutionizing how people engage with their iPhones. The deal signifies a significant step forward in AI integration within consumer technology. Read More

<hr>

The integration of large language models (LLMs) in healthcare shows promise but also raises critical questions. While LLMs offer potential benefits such as improved diagnostics and patient care, challenges like data privacy and bias remain. Stanford's report examines the current landscape, highlighting advancements and emphasizing the need for cautious implementation. As LLMs evolve, addressing ethical and technical concerns becomes imperative to realize their full potential in healthcare. Read More

<hr>

Scientists caution about AI's proficiency in deception, emphasizing its potential risks. AI systems can generate convincing falsehoods, posing threats like misinformation and fraud. Researchers advocate for stringent safeguards and ethical guidelines to mitigate these dangers. As AI capabilities advance, vigilance is crucial to safeguard against the misuse of deceptive AI and maintain trust in digital interactions and information dissemination. Read More

<hr>

Data Management

Forbes explores the ascent of AI-driven enterprise data management with Oracle Database 23AI. This innovation combines AI capabilities with database management, promising enhanced efficiency and insights. By automating tasks like performance tuning and security, Oracle aims to streamline operations and empower businesses with actionable intelligence from their data. The integration of AI into data management signifies a significant leap forward in optimizing enterprise processes and decision-making. Read More

<hr>

Federal agencies are reevaluating data management strategies to adapt to evolving needs. With the exponential growth of data, there's a shift towards modernizing infrastructure and leveraging advanced technologies like AI and cloud computing. This reframing emphasizes agility, security, and interoperability, enabling agencies to harness data more effectively for informed decision-making and improved citizen services. Embracing innovative approaches is vital for federal agencies to navigate the complexities of the digital age successfully. Read More

<hr>

Atlan secures funding for its AI-driven data control plane, enhancing data governance capabilities. This platform empowers organizations to efficiently manage and govern their data, ensuring compliance and maximizing insights. With AI integration, Atlan's solution enables automation and intelligent decision-making, bolstering data governance efforts. The funding underscores the growing importance of effective data management and governance in the era of big data and AI-driven insights. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, Darren interviews Robert Vaughn from Intel's award-winning IT@Intel program. Intel shares its IT best practices with its customers, and it is one of the most open and transparent IT organizations in the world. Robert and Darren discuss how organizations are using one of Intel's greatest assets, its people, to elevate the industry as a whole. Read More

briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance From May 5, 2024, key developments in digital transformation are highlighted. These advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity have significant implications for the future of technology and defen...
briefs.content:
Ubiquitous Computing

Vast Data Expands Global Namespace Features to Google Cloud: Vast Data, a leading storage platform, now offers its expansive global namespace capabilities on Google Cloud. This collaboration aims to enhance data management and accessibility for users on Google Cloud's platform. Simplifying data storage and retrieval, this integration promises improved efficiency and scalability for businesses utilizing Google Cloud services. Read More

<hr>

IBM Makes $6.4 Billion Bet on HashiCorp for Cloud Management Boost: IBM's strategic acquisition of HashiCorp, its second-largest to date, is a significant move towards automating multi-cloud use. HashiCorp's proven expertise in cloud setup, particularly its shared customer base with IBM, makes this a powerful partnership. This bold step underscores the increasing complexity of managing diverse cloud environments, a challenge that IBM is ready to tackle head-on. The deal reflects IBM's commitment to strengthening its cloud offerings, leveraging HashiCorp's developer community and open-source background to deliver top-notch cloud management solutions. Read More

<hr>

IBM and AWS Partner to Expand Software Portfolio: IBM's customer-centric approach is evident in its announcement of the extension of its software offerings to 92 countries through AWS Marketplace. This strategic alliance empowers businesses to access IBM's cutting-edge data technologies and AI solutions directly, simplifying procurement processes and streamlining purchasing. Leveraging AWS's committed spend for IBM software acquisitions, this collaboration is a testament to IBM's dedication to meeting customer needs and accelerating digital transformation journeys globally, ensuring a smooth and successful transition for businesses. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

AI-Controlled Fighter Jet Takes Air Force Leader on Historic Ride: A groundbreaking event occurred as an AI-controlled fighter jet took a top Air Force leader on a historic flight. This significant milestone highlights advancements in AI technology and its integration into military operations. The demonstration raises questions about the future role of AI in warfare and its potential impact on military strategy and decision-making. Read More

<hr>

AI Could Fuel Natural Gas Surge Amid Rising Electric Demand: As electric demand soars, utilities are turning to AI to optimize energy supply. Natural gas emerges as a critical player, bolstered by AI's predictive capabilities. This trend signals a potential natural gas boom, reshaping energy markets and strategies. AI-driven solutions promise greater efficiency and reliability in managing fluctuating energy demands, addressing the challenges of evolving consumption patterns. Read More

<hr>

Ukraine pioneers AI in diplomacy with Victoria Shi, an AI-generated spokesperson modeled after Rosalie Nombre. Shi's visual representation, resembling Nombre, engages audiences while delivering official statements. The initiative aims to streamline communication with human-written statements visually presented by AI. Developed by the Game Changers, Shi signifies a technological leap in diplomacy, reflecting Ukraine's commitment to innovation and efficiency in foreign affairs. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

U.S. Government Unveils AI Security Guidelines for Critical Infrastructure: The Department of Homeland Security has released new security guidelines to fortify critical infrastructure against AI-related threats. The guidelines address risks posed by AI systems across various sectors and emphasize the importance of transparency and secure design practices. Critical infrastructure operators are urged to assess AI risks and implement appropriate mitigations to safeguard against potential threats. Read More

<hr>

AI-Security Arms Race Intensifies Against Evolving Ransomware Threats: As cybercriminals increasingly weaponize AI capabilities, the cybersecurity industry is engaged in an arms race to counter evolving ransomware threats. IBM's AI-enhanced FlashCore Module technology represents a proactive response to the growing sophistication of cyber attacks, leveraging machine learning to detect ransomware anomalies with unprecedented speed and accuracy. With the proliferation of AI-driven cyber threats, organizations must invest in advanced cybersecurity solutions to safeguard against potential disruptions and data breaches. Read More

<hr>

Czechia and Germany disclosed cyber espionage by Russia's APT28, targeting their political entities and institutions. The hackers exploited a Microsoft Outlook flaw and compromised email accounts, implicating their role in the 2015 Bundestag attack. NATO and the EU condemned Russia's actions, highlighting the threat to democratic processes. A coordinated law enforcement action disrupted APT28's botnet, but concerns persist over continued cyber threats to elections and critical infrastructure. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, Darren is on an AI mission. He's been talking to experts about keeping GenAI safe from cyberattacks, getting your AI to run your household (finally, your dream of being a couch potato might come true!), and keeping your data secure with private GenAI and RAG. Head over to our website at embracingdigital.org to catch all the juicy details. Read More

briefs.title: April 28, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we examine critical advancements in digital transformation, focusing on artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and edge computing. Understanding the ongoing challenges such as AI-washing, security vulnerabilities fro...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

The latest Forbes article questions the necessity of a Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO). As AI's prominence grows, the need for dedicated leadership is scrutinized. Some argue for specialized oversight, citing AI's transformative potential. Others question the role's practicality and redundancy. As organizations navigate AI integration, discussions around the CAIO position highlight evolving approaches to AI governance and leadership structures. Read More

<hr>

Exciting educational developments: Eurasia Review explores how AI is transforming classrooms worldwide. From personalized learning to data-driven insights, AI is revolutionizing traditional teaching methods. AI is reshaping the educational landscape by adapting to individual student needs and providing real-time feedback. As schools embrace technology, the potential for enhanced learning experiences and improved outcomes becomes increasingly apparent. Stay tuned as AI continues to revolutionize the way we learn. Read More

<hr>

Analysts are looking into companies overhyping artificial intelligence (AI). As AI becomes ubiquitous, some organizations exaggerate their AI capabilities for marketing. This trend, termed 'AI-washing,' risks misleading consumers and investors. Bernard Marr discusses the importance of discerning genuine AI innovation from exaggerated claims, emphasizing the need for transparency and accountability in the AI landscape. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

A critical vulnerability in VMware ESXi Shell Service has been uncovered. According to GBHackers, this exploit could lead to unauthorized access and compromise of virtualized environments. VMware has released patches to address this issue. Users are strongly advised to apply updates immediately to mitigate the risk. Stay vigilant and secure your virtual infrastructure against potential threats. Read More

<hr>

GBHackers reports on a new SIM swap bribery scheme. Cybercriminals exploit this tactic to control victims' phone numbers, bypassing two-factor authentication and accessing sensitive accounts. Stay cautious and verify any unexpected requests from your mobile carrier. Educate yourself and your loved ones about the dangers of SIM swap fraud to prevent falling victim to this increasingly common scam. Read More

<hr>

The PlugX USB worm hits the streets. This malware infects USB drives and spreads rapidly through connected devices. The potential to steal sensitive data and compromise systems poses a serious risk to organizations and individuals. Stay vigilant, avoid using unknown USB drives, and keep your security software up to date to protect against this evolving threat. Read More

<hr>

Edge Computing

IoT devices face escalating cyber threats. Hackers target vulnerabilities in intelligent gadgets, risking personal and organizational data. Despite their convenience, these devices demand heightened security measures. Regular updates and investing in security solutions are crucial. Stay informed and proactive to safeguard your digital life. More updates soon. Stay vigilant. Read More

<hr>

Multi-Access Edge Computing (MEC) is revolutionizing connectivity. As highlighted in a recent article, MEC brings computing power closer to end-users, enhancing speed and efficiency for applications like AR/VR and IoT. With MEC, data processing occurs closer to the source, reducing latency and improving user experience. Stay tuned for more insights into this transformative technology. Read More

<hr>

Intel's Meteor Lake chips are set to revolutionize edge computing. As reported by Tom's Hardware, these chips integrate Arc graphics and NPU for AI workloads packed into a socket. This advancement promises enhanced performance and efficiency for edge applications. Keep an eye out for Intel's latest innovations reshaping the computing landscape. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, Darren continues his interview with Michael Greenberg as they find out how small and mid-size businesses are challenging and winning against large competitors by using Generative AI to improve customer relationships, including lead generation, customer services, and customer acquisition. Read More
