briefs.title: April 21, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week highlights significant developments in Digital Transformation, focusing on Data Management, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. Understanding these advancements is crucial for organizations aiming to stay compe...
briefs.content:
Data Management

Microsoft's "Open Lakes, Not Walled Gardens" initiative aims to revolutionize data analytics with a unified data lake and integrated analytic engines, prioritizing openness, security, and global data estate governance. With built-in security controls and integration with Microsoft Purview, the vision promises to enable analytics without proprietary lock-ins. Future plans include cross-cloud and cross-tenant data sharing, aligning with the demand for streamlined analytics on expansive data estates. Stay tuned for updates. Read More

<hr>

Altair, a leading computational intelligence firm, has acquired Cambridge Semantics, a renowned data fabric provider. The acquisition is expected to expand Altair's data analytics and artificial intelligence offerings significantly. The move aims to enable organizations to build advanced analytics ecosystems with AI infusion by integrating Cambridge Semantics' knowledge graph technology with Altair's tools. The acquisition will also enrich Altair's RapidMiner platform with features such as knowledge graphs, data governance, and data discovery, which could revolutionize enterprise data fabrics and generative AI. Read More

<hr>

Cohesity introduces Gaia, an AI-powered enterprise search assistant that is revolutionizing data access. By leveraging enterprise backup data, Gaia offers conversational search capabilities, enabling users to interact with their data using natural language. Unlike traditional engines, Gaia directly answers queries based on indexed data, simplifying data retrieval. Built on stringent security measures, Gaia ensures data protection and compliance. Analysts applaud its strategic enhancement and scalability, positioning Cohesity as a data management and protection leader. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

Microsoft Research Asia has developed VASA-1, an AI model that can generate synchronized animated videos of individuals speaking or singing from a single photo and an existing audio track. With the ability to analyze images and audio using machine learning, it creates realistic videos with precise facial expressions and lip-syncing. The innovation eliminates the need for video feeds and allows virtual avatars to be rendered locally with real-time applications such as video conferencing. However, researchers have opted to withhold code release due to concerns about misuse. Read More

<hr>

Meta introduces Llama 3, its latest large language model. At the same time, Intel validates its AI product portfolio for Llama 3 8B and 70B models across Gaudi accelerators, Xeon processors, Core Ultra processors, and Arc GPUs. This collaboration ensures readiness for cutting-edge AI innovations, with optimized performance results using open-source software like PyTorch and DeepSpeed. The partnership aims to provide development and deployment capabilities across various hardware platforms, with plans for further enhancements in the coming months. Read More

<hr>

In partnership with Iron Bow, Intel's AI PC solutions are reshaping government workflows by integrating AI directly into processors. This eliminates the need for external servers, providing AI capabilities directly on workstations and laptops. With optimized performance and enhanced efficiency through API acceleration, government agencies achieve sustainability goals while empowering employees with self-help capabilities. This technology fosters collaboration and innovation, driving mission success and addressing evolving societal needs, contingent on agencies' flexibility and commitment to continuous learning. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

Water facilities are increasingly vulnerable to cybersecurity threats, prompting the EPA and White House to urge states to submit plans to address risks by June 28. The proposed legislation seeks to mandate cybersecurity standards, but budget constraints hamper efforts. Hackers, including state-sponsored actors, pose significant risks, leaving many facilities vulnerable despite investments. Safeguarding critical infrastructure remains an ongoing challenge, with persistent vulnerabilities underscoring the difficulty of addressing these threats. The EPA's withdrawal of cybersecurity guidelines highlights the complexity of the issue. Read More

<hr>

Cisco has launched HyperShield, an AI-powered security system that safeguards applications, devices, and data across various IT environments. This move aims to enhance Cisco's position in the cybersecurity market following its recent acquisition of Splunk. HyperShield provides autonomous segmentation and self-qualifying upgrades to improve security and streamline operations, addressing critical infrastructure needs. Cisco's goal is to become a significant player in the AI security landscape, and this launch will help them achieve that aim amidst growing competition. Read More

<hr>

The National Security Agency (NSA) has released a Cybersecurity Information Sheet (CSI) with best practices for deploying secure and resilient AI systems. Developed in collaboration with various cybersecurity agencies, including CISA and the FBI, the guidance is aimed at National Security System owners and Defense Industrial Base companies. The CSI provides insights on safeguarding AI systems against malicious activities and is the first release from the NSA's Artificial Intelligence Security Center (AISC) under the Cybersecurity Collaboration Center (CCC). The AISC plans to release more guidance on various AI security topics. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

Darren interviews Michael Greenberg this week and discusses GenAI, RPA, and process automation for small and mid-sized companies. The second part of the interview will be available next week. Remember to come back and listen to it. Also, spread the news with your smart speaker and ask for "Embracing Digital This Week" in your daily briefing. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: April 14, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, key developments in digital transformation focus on 5G, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence, shaping the future of technology. Understanding these advancements is crucial as they directly influence innovation, ...
briefs.content:
Advanced Communications

In wireless woes, Redzone and NextWave join the chorus of complaints against T-Mobile's 5G interference. These smaller carriers claim their signals play hide and seek amidst T-Mobile's 5G spectrum. It's a "Can you hear me now?" with a twist. While the big players battle for bandwidth, spare a thought for the little guys caught in the signal shuffle. Read More

<hr>

Amidst the 5G spectrum scuffle, the Pentagon throws its hat into the ring, demanding new rules if it has to share. With military might on the line, they're not just asking for a slice of the pie; they want a whole new recipe. As the battle for bandwidth rages on, everyone's got a stake in the 5G game, from telecom titans to national defense. Keep your antennas up for the latest twists and turns! Read More

<hr>

As 5G towers sprout like mushrooms, concerns arise over their impact on phone battery life. Researchers delve into the effects of these pint-sized powerhouses, aiming to ease worries about dwindling battery bars. While the promise of lightning-fast internet beckons, the price may be paid in battery power. As we navigate the brave new world of 5G, it's a balancing act between speed and staying powered up. Stay charged and connected, folks! Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

A new cybersecurity bill aims to safeguard water and wastewater systems from digital threats. With cyberattacks lurking in the shadows, this legislation fortifies critical infrastructure. As our reliance on technology deepens, so do the risks. We're shoring up the frontlines against potential digital deluges by bolstering defenses. In the battle for cyber supremacy, legislation like this helps keep our essential services flowing smoothly. Read More

<hr>

Hackers strike again, deploying a Python backdoor in Palo Alto Networks firewalls. As cybersecurity battles rage on, even the giants aren't spared. This breach raises eyebrows and alarms, highlighting the constant cat-and-mouse game between hackers and defenders. With digital predators lurking in the shadows, vigilance is paramount. As we navigate the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats, staying one step ahead is our best defense. Read More

<hr>

The cyber war continues as nation-state hackers engage in a cyber attack targeting XZ Utils, vital software used in Windows and Linux systems. Over several months, these hackers have inserted backdoors into computing systems by gaining the trust of the open-source community. The incident serves as a harsh reminder of the risks in the digital world as technology continues to tread a thin line between innovation and vulnerability. This attack highlights the vulnerability of single-developer open-source packages, which the industry relies heavily upon. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

Intel unveils its Vision 2024, introducing the Gaudi 3 AI accelerator to supercharge artificial intelligence capabilities. With the race for AI dominance heating up, Intel strides confidently into the fray with this cutting-edge innovation. As the digital landscape continues to evolve, the promise of more innovative, faster AI opens doors to new possibilities. With Gaudi 3 leading the charge, Intel's vision for the future of AI is sharper and more ambitious than ever. Read More

<hr>

The US government is ramping up efforts to regulate AI, navigating the delicate balance between innovation and oversight. With AI's potential to reshape industries and societies, policymakers are forging ahead with cautious steps to ensure ethical and responsible development. From privacy concerns to bias mitigation, the regulatory landscape is evolving to address the complexities of AI's impact. As Uncle Sam dons his digital watchdog hat, the future of AI regulation in America hangs in the balance. Read More

<hr>

Context-aware AI models emerge as game-changers for government workflows, courtesy of Iron Bow Technologies. By blending AI with contextual understanding, these models revolutionize how governments tackle complex tasks. The potential applications are vast, from enhancing decision-making to optimizing efficiency. As government agencies embrace the power of context-aware AI, they're poised to unlock new levels of productivity and effectiveness. In the ever-evolving landscape of technology, innovation like this paves the way for smarter governance. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

Darren has a unique opportunity to interview two colleagues on stage at the HPE CTO Summit in Houston this year. Check out this podcast episode this week as they explore Intel's effort to Digitally Transform the industry with new technology, an increased set of ecosystem partners, and a holistic approach to solutioning. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: April 08, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week highlights significant developments in Cloud Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. Key concerns arise regarding Microsoft breaches, making cybersecurity a central focus. Additionally, advancements in ...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

Iron Bow Technologies unveils AI-powered PCs to enhance government workforce efficiency. The innovative solution integrates artificial intelligence to streamline tasks, improve decision-making, and boost productivity across various sectors. The AI PC is designed to meet stringent government standards, and promises enhanced security features. Its deployment marks a significant step towards leveraging cutting-edge technology to empower public sector employees and optimize operations. Read More

<hr>

Intel is poised to outpace AMD and Qualcomm in smartphone AI integration but faces a key obstacle. Despite Intel's advancements, power consumption remains challenging, hindering widespread adoption. While AMD and Qualcomm lead in energy-efficient designs, Intel's AI capabilities could revolutionize mobile technology if power efficiency hurdles are overcome. Market analysts anticipate intense competition as companies race to dominate the AI smartphone landscape, with power efficiency emerging as the decisive factor. Read More

<hr>

Tech giants are under scrutiny for extensive data harvesting practices to fuel artificial intelligence systems. Companies like Google, Facebook, and Amazon collect vast amounts of user data, raising concerns over privacy and monopolistic behavior. This data fuels AI algorithms, enabling targeted advertising and personalized services. Critics argue for stricter regulations to curb data exploitation and promote user privacy. As AI reliance grows, balancing innovation with ethical data usage becomes paramount in tech's future. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

Cybersecurity experts warn that hackers exploit PDF files as weaponized tools. These malicious PDFs serve as vectors for malware, enabling attackers to infiltrate systems and compromise sensitive data. By exploiting vulnerabilities in PDF reader software, hackers can execute harmful code without user interaction. Users are urged to exercise caution when opening PDF attachments and ensure their software is up-to-date. Vigilance and robust cybersecurity measures are crucial to thwart these evolving threats. Read More

<hr>

NVD and NIST announce enhanced support solutions to bolster cybersecurity efforts. The National Vulnerability Database (NVD) and the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) introduce measures to streamline vulnerability management processes and improve information dissemination. These initiatives aim to empower organizations to efficiently identify and address security vulnerabilities, ultimately enhancing overall cybersecurity posture. The collaboration underscores the commitment to advancing cybersecurity standards and facilitating proactive risk mitigation strategies. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity experts warn that "AI Package Hallucination" poses a new threat. This technique involves deceiving AI models by injecting malicious data into pre-trained models, leading to erroneous outcomes. Hackers exploit vulnerabilities in AI algorithms to manipulate results, potentially causing significant harm. Cybersecurity professionals urge vigilance and the adoption of robust defense measures to counter this emerging threat. Stay informed to safeguard against evolving cyber risks. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

Cloud Software Group and Microsoft forge an eight-year strategic partnership to deliver joint cloud solutions and generative AI to over 100 million users. The collaboration aims to enhance digital transformation across various industries by leveraging Microsoft's Azure cloud platform and Cloud Software Group's expertise. With a focus on innovation and scalability, both companies seek to empower organizations worldwide with advanced cloud technologies and AI-driven solutions. The partnership heralds a new era of digital empowerment and collaboration. Read More

<hr>

The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Regulatory Board criticizes Microsoft for inadequate federal cloud security measures, urging prompt updates. The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency Regulatory Board highlights vulnerabilities in Microsoft's cloud offerings, emphasizing the urgency for enhanced security protocols. As federal agencies increasingly rely on cloud services, ensuring robust cybersecurity measures is paramount to safeguard sensitive data. The critique underscores the importance of continuous improvement in cloud security standards to mitigate cyber threats effectively. Read More

<hr>

A report cautions that inadequate architectural visibility is causing cloud cost overruns. Organizations struggle to manage expenses due to a lack of insight into cloud architecture, resulting in unexpected costs. The report emphasizes the importance of enhancing visibility and implementing cost management strategies to mitigate financial risks associated with cloud usage. Improved transparency is crucial for optimizing cloud expenditure and maximizing return on investment. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

It's great to see that Darren had the opportunity to continue his interview with Dave Burrill on the topic of Embracing Digital Transformation. Through their conversation, Darren sheds light on the lost art of a Business Analyst, which is sure to be insightful for his audience. It's wonderful to know that the podcast and videos are being shared with more people, and the Embracing Digital Universe is growing each week with over 29,000 weekly downloads. Let's continue to spread the word and thank you to everyone who has contributed to its success. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: March 31, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore key developments in Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, and Edge Computing as of March 31, 2024. The adoption of AI in education signifies a major shift in learning methodologies. Meanwhile, government ...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

Dr. Marylyn Ritchie has been appointed the inaugural dean of artificial intelligence and computing at the University of Pennsylvania. Her expertise will steer interdisciplinary research and education in AI and foster collaboration across departments to address societal challenges. This appointment highlights Penn's commitment to advancing AI innovation and its transformative potential in various fields. Read More

<hr>

MIT's new program teaches AI concepts to preschoolers, developing their critical thinking skills through interactive activities. The initiative aims to bridge the workforce skills gap by emphasizing the importance of early AI education. The program aligns with global efforts to integrate AI education into curricula at all educational levels, ensuring readiness for the AI-driven future. Read More

<hr>

Palo Alto Unified School District is exploring AI integration to enhance learning experiences and provide personalized education. The district hopes to cater to individual student needs and improve academic outcomes. However, concerns regarding data privacy and equitable access have been raised. This reflects ongoing efforts to innovate education in Palo Alto. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

AT&T reports a breach impacting 73 million account holders. Leaked data contained sensitive information like Social Security numbers and financial data. The company is taking proactive measures, such as notifying affected individuals and enhancing security protocols. This event stresses the ongoing cybersecurity challenges and highlights the need for robust data protection measures in the digital age. Read More

<hr>

The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) is creating a centralized hub for healthcare cybersecurity to assist organizations in tackling cybersecurity issues. To strengthen the sector's resilience against cyber threats, HHS will provide guidance, tools, and information sharing. This aligns with broader initiatives to safeguard sensitive healthcare data and fortify critical infrastructure cybersecurity. Read More

<hr>

ConnectWise's 2024 MSP Threat Report warns of the rising sophistication of cyberattacks, such as ransomware and supply chain vulnerabilities, faced by Managed Service Providers (MSPs). MSPs must develop robust cybersecurity strategies and proactively safeguard client networks and data. The report provides valuable insights and guidance for MSPs to navigate the rapidly evolving threat landscape and enhance their cybersecurity posture. Read More

<hr>

Edge Computing

The International Data Corporation (IDC) forecasts significant growth in the global semiconductor market, projecting a 10.8% increase in 2024. This surge is attributed to robust demand across various sectors, including automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics. Despite ongoing supply chain challenges, the semiconductor market is expected to thrive, driven by advancements in AI, 5G, and IoT technologies. IDC's insights provide valuable foresight for stakeholders navigating the dynamic semiconductor landscape. Read More

<hr>

Edge AI is set for exponential growth, driven by 5G, low-power AI chips, and cloud integration. With real-time data processing, edge computing reduces latency and enhances AI capabilities. This convergence of technologies signals a transformative era for AI deployment, promising efficiency and innovation across various industries. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

ZOTAC unveils a new series of NPU-accelerated ZBOX AI PCs powered by Intel Core Ultra processors. These systems integrate Neural Processing Units (NPUs) to enhance AI performance, enabling tasks like image recognition and natural language processing. With compact form factors, the ZBOX AI PCs cater to various applications, from home entertainment to industrial automation. ZOTAC's innovation reflects the growing demand for AI-enabled computing solutions in diverse sectors.This week, in the Embracing Digital Transformation podcast, Darren interviews Dave Burrill about learning from IT project failures and how to avoid them. Also, check out our live-streaming ED-T the Fish to catch up on the latest news. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: March 24, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, explore key developments in digital transformation, particularly in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and ubiquitous computing. These topics are crucial as advancements in technology can significantly impact sec...
briefs.content:
Artificial Intelligence

Generative AI, popularized by ChatGPT, has hundreds of millions of weekly users and a multi-trillion-dollar projected economic impact. Filtered Technologies' research found 100 real-world applications including technical assistance, content creation, personal support, learning, creativity, and research. Despite challenges, users appreciate AI for generating ideas, problem-solving, and streamlined workflows. Concerns remain about reliability and widespread utilization. Read More

<hr>

The US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has started implementing AI initiatives, which include three test projects. One of these projects involves training immigration officers with generative AI to improve training and decision-making accuracy. However, there are concerns about potential inaccuracies and biases inherent in AI models. Despite assurances of responsible use, challenges remain in ensuring privacy, transparency, and bias mitigation. The DHS's comprehensive AI roadmap highlights both the opportunities and risks of deploying AI across its operations. Read More

<hr>

Chatbots using genAI automate tasks in enterprise systems like customer record updates and code creation. IDC calls these AI assistants "copilots" and envisages them as standard software interfaces. While Microsoft dominates with its Copilot, other vendors like Slack and Salesforce are entering the market. Amazon's CodeWhisperer leads in software code generation. These copilots augment software development and offer guidance in enterprise applications. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

Five Eyes agencies, comprising the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, issue a joint warning urging critical infrastructure operators to prioritize defense against the Volt Typhoon cyber threat. This China-backed campaign poses serious risks to national security. Enhanced cybersecurity measures are recommended to mitigate potential disruptions. Collaboration between government and private sectors is crucial in safeguarding critical infrastructure against emerging cyber threats. Read More

<hr>

At a Billington State and Local Cybersecurity Summit, CISA's Andrew Scott revealed that China-backed cyber actors have infiltrated US critical infrastructure networks for up to five years, posing potential disruption threats. CISA's advisory warns of China's Volt Typhoon compromising IT systems across sectors. Despite skepticism, experts stress vigilance among state and local governments. Tabletop exercises and incident response training are recommended to enhance cybersecurity resilience. Read More

<hr>

State-backed hackers from Iran and China have increased cyberattacks on critical infrastructure, prompting a warning from the US government. Cybersecurity agencies have investigated Iranian attacks on water facilities, while China's Volt Typhoon group is suspected of probing various infrastructure sectors. These attacks threaten safe drinking water and could disrupt essential services. The Biden Administration urges private enterprises to take proactive steps to improve cybersecurity and mitigate risks. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

Watch out for those sneaky cloud service providers!! Google, AWS, and Microsoft have waived egress fees for a few weeks to reduce data migration costs and encourage multi-cloud adoption. But these waivers come with conditions such as data transfer limits and approval requirements. Google offers credits, AWS provides one terabyte of free data transfer per month, and Azure requires approval for transfers exceeding 100GB/month. To avoid unexpected costs, review the terms carefully. Read More

<hr>

Snowflake and Reka have teamed up to integrate multimodal large language models into Snowflake's data cloud platform, enabling users to develop generative AI apps handling text, images, and videos. The collaboration will incorporate Reka's Flash and Core models into Snowflake's Cortex, designed for LLM apps. Snowflake aims to democratize AI, and this move aligns with its commitment to innovation and accessibility. With more than 400 enterprises using Cortex, this partnership will speed up the delivery of business value. Read More

<hr>

Hellmann's, a company known for its mayonnaise, has introduced a new tool called Meal Reveal that uses AI and cloud technology to help reduce household food waste. By scanning the contents of a fridge with a phone, the AI analyzes the ingredients and suggests recipes in real-time using Google Cloud's Vertex AI platform. This tool aims to tackle food waste and was launched during WRAP UK's Food Waste Action Week. It showcases the potential of generative AI in improving food systems. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week on Embracing Digital Transformation, Darren discusses identity with his guest Jeff Reich. They delve into the complex topic of identity in the cyber realm, addressing questions such as: how many identities we have, how can we trust someone or something's identity, and who can verify a person's true identity. In addition, don't forget to check out the new features on our website and YouTube channel. We are having a bit of fun this week, as we introduce ED-T the fish, our podcast mascot. Read More

briefs.title: March 17, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore key developments in digital transformation, focusing on cyber security, artificial intelligence, and ubiquitous computing. Understanding these trends helps organizations navigate the evolving digital landsc...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

Recent security breaches involving Azure cloud and source code access have raised concerns over data protection for US government customers of Microsoft. Despite assurances from the tech giant, skepticism looms as officials seek reassurance and customers worry about the integrity of their sensitive information. The incident highlights the ongoing battle to safeguard digital assets in an increasingly interconnected world. Read More

<hr>

Millions of patients' sensitive information was compromised in a data breach at UnitedHealth Group and Change Healthcare. The Department of Health and Human Services is investigating the breach, which could have included patient data such as diagnoses and treatments. The incident highlights the vulnerability of healthcare systems to cyberattacks and emphasizes the need for strong cybersecurity measures. UnitedHealth reassures patients of their commitment to data security, while HHS vows to hold responsible parties accountable. Read More

<hr>

At the recent S4X24 conference, experts warn of "Volt Typhoon" malware targeting critical infrastructure, posing significant cyber threats. The malware, linked to state-sponsored Chinese actors, can disrupt industrial control systems. Analysts raise alarms over its ability to cause widespread damage, emphasizing the urgency for enhanced cybersecurity measures. While specifics of the malware remain undisclosed, its potential impact on critical infrastructure underscores the need for vigilance and cooperation among cybersecurity professionals to thwart such attacks. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

The EU's AI Act has sparked mixed reactions. Critics fear stifling innovation, while proponents praise its focus on transparency and accountability. The legislation aims to regulate AI systems to balance innovation with ethical concerns. The Act's impact on tech companies and AI development remains uncertain, highlighting ongoing debates over the ethical use of AI and adaptable regulatory frameworks in the digital age. Read More

<hr>

AI is revolutionizing healthcare and wellness. The FDA sees great potential in AI for enhanced medical product development and regulatory processes, leading to improved patient outcomes. Personal care is also being transformed by AI, providing tailored recommendations and insights for skincare and mental health management. From drug discovery to holistic wellness, AI is promising unprecedented customization and effectiveness, marking a significant shift in healthcare and wellness paradigms. Read More

<hr>

The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints embraces the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) while setting ethical guidelines for its use. The principles introduced by Elder Gerrit W. Gong and Elder John C. Pingree emphasize spiritual connection, transparency, privacy, and accountability. AI will aid in positive endeavors like family history work and language translation. However, caution is advised against misuse, especially concerning deepfakes. Wisdom, reliance on the Holy Spirit, and trusted sources are highlighted as essential safeguards in navigating this technological landscape. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

A global IT outage that impacted McDonald's restaurants worldwide was caused by a third-party error. The issue was traced back to a problem with a third-party supplier's software. While the problem was resolved quickly, this highlights the importance of robust oversight in managing third-party dependencies. This incident underscores the critical need for businesses to prioritize resilience and redundancy in their digital ecosystems. Read More

<hr>

Intel's latest Gaudi 2 accelerator outperforms Nvidia's H100 GPU by 55% according to AI benchmark showdown results. The Gaudi 2 also boasts remarkable stability, with Stable Diffusion processes three times faster than Nvidia's A100. This marks a significant leap forward in AI hardware capabilities, promising exciting innovations for future AI applications and fierce competition in the accelerator market. Read More

<hr>

Cloud providers like Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud are reducing egress fees to encourage businesses to use cloud services more extensively. This strategic move aims to make it more cost-effective for customers to move data out of their platforms and remove barriers to data transfer. It reflects the competitive nature of the cloud market and underscores the providers' commitment to enhancing customer experience and value. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

This week, on Embracing Digital Transformation, Darren interviews Lelani Bloomquist, a digital transformation consultant for Fortune 500 companies. She shares her journey and sheds light on the cultural shifts and executive leadership helping organizations embrace digital transformation and move forward in these rapidly changing times. Don’t forget to listen and share with your friends. Read More

briefs.title: March 10, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week’s digital transformation highlights feature significant developments from the Mobile World Congress, shedding light on advancements in mobile technology. The ongoing transition towards AI-driven edge computing, the rev...
briefs.content:
Edge Computing

Intel has unveiled a groundbreaking Edge platform poised to transform the landscape of AI applications across various industries. Tailored for edge computing, the platform boasts enhanced efficiency and performance, addressing the growing demand for scalable and powerful AI solutions. This development underscores Intel's strategic commitment to pushing the boundaries of AI technology, with the potential to revolutionize applications in fields ranging from healthcare to manufacturing. The platform represents a pivotal step forward in democratizing and deploying impactful AI solutions at scale. Read More

<hr>

NTT and Schneider Electric have joined forces to integrate private 5G technology into an edge data center bundle tailored for Industry 4.0. This collaboration aims to provide advanced connectivity solutions, optimizing industrial processes. Integrating private 5G enhances data center capabilities, fostering efficient communication and supporting the demands of Industry 4.0 applications. This initiative reflects the ongoing efforts to leverage cutting-edge technologies for industrial innovation and digital transformation. Read More

<hr>

Connectivity and edge computing are highlighted at Mobile World Congress 2024. The event focuses on the pivotal role of these technologies in shaping the future of mobile communication. Discussions cover 5G, IoT, and edge computing advancements, emphasizing their impact on diverse industries. Key industry players showcase innovations, highlighting the crucial interplay between connectivity and edge computing in driving digital transformation. The Mobile World Congress serves as a platform to explore and harness the potential of these technologies for the evolving digital landscape. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity

In a significant incident, a top U.S. cybersecurity agency has been hacked, compelling the organization to take specific systems offline. The breach raises concerns about the vulnerability of critical cybersecurity infrastructure. Investigations are underway to assess the extent of the compromise and identify potential repercussions. The incident underscores the ongoing challenges in safeguarding vital systems against cyber threats and emphasizes the need for continuous vigilance in the face of evolving cybersecurity risks. Read More

<hr>

Microsoft has officially confirmed a cyber attack by Russian hackers. The breach exploited a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange servers, potentially compromising sensitive data. The company is actively working on security updates to address the issue. This incident highlights the persistent threat posed by sophisticated cyber adversaries and emphasizes the critical role of timely software updates and cybersecurity measures. Users are urged to stay vigilant and apply patches promptly to enhance their digital security. Read More

<hr>

NIST has announced the release of version 2.0 of the Cybersecurity Framework (CSF). The updated framework, a crucial resource for organizations in enhancing their cybersecurity posture, includes improvements based on user feedback. It provides comprehensive guidance on risk management and cybersecurity practices. The release aligns with NIST's commitment to fostering cybersecurity resilience, offering organizations an updated and robust framework to address evolving cyber threats. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

The competition in the Cloud Wars is intensifying as Google and AWS have significantly changed their pricing strategies. Google has eliminated data egress charges, while AWS has followed suit by removing transfer fees for data leaving its cloud. These moves align with a shared industry trend towards transparent, cost-effective cloud services. Both companies have made these changes effective worldwide in response to pressure from the EU and the European Data Act. It is expected that other cloud service providers will follow suit. Read More

<hr>

Organizations are increasingly undertaking cloud repatriation projects, moving workloads from the cloud back to on-premises or alternate environments. Citing factors like cost management, data security, and performance optimization, this trend reflects a nuanced approach to cloud strategies. The article underscores the need for businesses to continually assess and adapt their cloud deployment models to meet evolving needs, ensuring a balance between the benefits of the cloud and specific operational requirements. Read More

<hr>

The National Security Agency (NSA) has recently unveiled its top ten cloud security mitigation strategies to enhance cybersecurity and improve the security of using cloud technology. These strategies focus on critical factors such as data protection, identity management, and secure configuration. They serve as a comprehensive guide for organizations dealing with the complex landscape of cloud security. The release highlights the NSA's commitment to providing actionable insights and strengthening the resilience of cloud environments against evolving cyber threats. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

I want to thank our listeners for helping us spread the word about our podcast. Last month, we recorded over 65,000 downloads and couldn't have done it without your support. This week's episode will discuss product assurance and chip security with Intel's Senior Director of Product Assurance, Jerry Bryant. We will be taking a deep dive into the topic and discussing how Intel's investments are paying off in improving their product security. Read More

briefs.title: March 03, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance Stay updated with the latest advancements in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and data management for the week of March 3, 2024. Key topics this week include the implications of ransomware payouts, technical setbacks at G...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

In light of the increasing cyber threats, nations in the Indo-Pacific region are advised to give priority to cybersecurity to protect their economies and infrastructure. It is emphasized that collaborative efforts are necessary to tackle the changing challenges in the digital realm. Experts stress the significance of developing strong cybersecurity frameworks and information-sharing mechanisms to counter cyber threats in the region. Read More

<hr>

Intel has released its 5th annual product security report for 2023, highlighting its commitment to cybersecurity. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger has challenged the industry to match Intel's investments in the field. ABI Research ranked Intel #1 in product security assurance across the silicon industry, with Intel outperforming AMD in various categories. Intel emphasizes its dedication to continuous improvement in product security assurance. Read More

<hr>

Cybersecurity experts are divided over a proposed ban on ransomware payments. Supporters say it would disrupt the economic model of cybercriminals and discourage attacks, while opponents worry it could leave victims with no way to recover their data. The debate highlights the challenges involved in combatting ransomware, with differing opinions on the most effective strategies to address the growing threat. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

Google CEO Sundar Pichai has called the company's failure to generate images during the launch of the Gemini operating system "unacceptable." Pichai has promised a thorough investigation and a commitment to rectifying the issue. The Gemini operating system, which was designed to provide enhanced privacy, faced significant backlash due to performance problems and technical glitches. These comments from Pichai emphasize Google's dedication to addressing user concerns and improving the reliability of its products. Read More

<hr>

OpenAI has developed SORA, a text-to-video generator that uses GPT-3.5 to turn written prompts into video content. The technology combines textual input with video output, demonstrating the potential of multimodal AI for creative content generation. Despite some challenges related to coherence and accuracy, SORA represents a significant step forward for the field, opening up new possibilities for diverse applications. Read More

<hr>

Intel is aiming to provide chips for 100 million AI-powered personal computers by 2025. The company plans to integrate specialized AI accelerators into its processors to enhance the performance and efficiency of the devices. This initiative aligns with Intel's broader strategy to advance AI technologies and highlights the growing integration of AI into everyday computing devices. Read More

<hr>

Data Management

LinkedIn has open-sourced OpenHouse, its data lakehouse management tool, to encourage collaboration and innovation in the data analytics community. OpenHouse helps simplify the management of data lakehouses, which combine data lakes and data warehouses for improved efficiency. LinkedIn's move reflects its commitment to advancing data analytics solutions and fostering a collaborative environment. Read More

<hr>

Informatica has launched its Cloud Data Access Management solution, which combines data access control with classification and metadata tools for data-driven organizations. The solution uses the CLAIRE AI engine to automate sensitive data classifications, ensuring compliance and trust. CDAM also integrates with Informatica's Intelligent Data Management Cloud to provide secure and automated AI and analytics use cases, addressing data privacy challenges and enhancing security across diverse environments. Read More

<hr>

Insurers are adopting data mesh strategies to increase their agility during digital transformation. This approach involves decentralizing data ownership and creating domain-specific data products to promote flexibility and collaboration. Insurers are leveraging data mesh to adapt to the changing digital landscape and align with their goals of being responsive and adaptable to technological changes. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

On this week's episode of the Embracing Digital Transformation Podcast, Darren discusses the convergence of HPC, supercomputers, cloud technology, and artificial intelligence with the CEO of Parallel Works. Parallel Works offers a simplified approach to managing workloads and dynamic supercomputing clusters both on-premises and in the cloud. Read More

briefs.title: February 25, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore critical developments in digital transformation, focusing on cybersecurity, computing, and advanced communication technologies. Understanding these advancements is essential for navigating the evolving land...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

Intel's 2023 product security report revealed that they detected 94% of vulnerabilities proactively, had three times fewer firmware bugs than AMD, and experienced a 150% increase in unique security researchers engaged. This highlights Intel's industry leadership, proactive approach to security, success in identifying and fixing vulnerabilities, and engagement with researchers. These efforts are crucial in protecting against the growing frequency and sophistication of cyber-attacks. Read More

<hr>

On February 24, 2024, UnitedHealth experienced a cyber security issue that has impacted their ability to provide healthcare services. The nature and extent of the attack are currently unknown, but the disruption has caused challenges to the company's operations. UnitedHealth is actively working to address the issue and restore normalcy to their services. Further investigation is underway to determine the source and impact of the cyber security breach. Read More

<hr>

Healthcare is still being targeted by cyber-attacks, and over the February 24-25, 2024 weekend, a nationwide cyber security issue caused delays and disruptions to pharmacy services across the United States. Although the specific nature of the cyber security problem and its consequences for pharmacies are still unknown, efforts are underway to investigate the situation and resolve the issue as soon as possible. The goal is to minimize any further disruptions to pharmacy services on a national level. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

The global AI market was valued at $27 billion in 2019 and is expected to reach $400 billion by 2027, with a Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) of 40%. This growth is primarily due to the increased adoption of AI in sectors such as healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing. With tech giants such as OpenAI and Intel driving innovation in machine learning and AI chips, the market is experiencing significant growth. These advancements highlight a future in which AI technologies will play a crucial role in reshaping industries and fostering innovation. Read More

<hr>

IBM Cloud places a high priority on data sovereignty and provides customized solutions to clients operating in heavily regulated industries. The Enterprise Cloud for Regulated Industries, which includes IBM Cloud for Financial Services, is designed to address sector-specific requirements, with a focus on data residency and privacy. IBM's latest services offer innovative approaches to data protection, such as advanced encryption, confidential computing, and data security measures. This commitment helps clients globally to meet evolving regulations while building trust and resilience in the adoption of cloud services for highly regulated sectors. Read More

<hr>

As concerns over costs, data security, and infrastructure control continue to grow, organizations are opting for cloud repatriation projects. This involves moving data and applications from the cloud back to on-premises or private cloud environments. To optimize cloud strategies, businesses are taking a more nuanced approach, considering the benefits of cloud services against specific operational and regulatory requirements. It is vital for organizations to tailor their cloud deployment models to individual business needs, ensuring a well-planned and customized cloud strategy that meets evolving considerations. Read More

<hr>

Advanced Communications

AT&T experienced a temporary outage on February 22, 2024, attributed to a software update error during network expansion, not a cyberattack. The disruption affected wireless services for some customers but has been fully restored. Investigating agencies, including the FBI and DHS, found no signs of malicious activity. AT&T apologized and assured steps to avoid future incidents. Competitors Verizon and T-Mobile reported normal operations but acknowledged potential challenges when connecting with affected AT&T users. Read More

<hr>

In a groundbreaking initiative, NTT and SKY Perfect JSAT are developing the Space Integrated Computing Network, a satellite networking system that utilizes space-based data centers powered by photonics and optical technology. This innovative approach aims to overcome the limitations of Earth-bound data processing, offering faster data analysis, reduced power consumption, and improved resistance to space radiation. The Space Integrated Computing Network is expected to launch in 2025, ushering in a new era of sustainable and resilient data infrastructure by harnessing the power of space. Read More

<hr>

Verizon Business and Audi have collaborated to establish a private 5G wireless network at Audi's test track in Germany, replicating global connectivity environments. The network, equipped with Nokia's dual 5G and LTE platform, Amazon Web Services' multi-access edge computing, and other technologies, facilitates testing of various applications, including voice, video, safety features, autonomous mobility, and cellular vehicle-to-everything (C-V2X) functionalities. This collaboration aims to enhance testing efficiency and provide a competitive edge in the global marketplace. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation

Darren interviewed Dan Berges, the Managing Director and Founder of Berges Institute, about his experience with digital transformation during the COVID-19 pandemic. Due to the pandemic, Dan's in-person Spanish language training school was shut down in the early days of the crisis. However, within weeks of the shutdown, the school was able to successfully transition to a fully online platform. Not only did this save the school, but it also led to an increase in the number of students enrolled. Read More

<hr>

briefs.title: February 18, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore significant developments in digital transformation, focusing on healthcare cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and IoT edge computing. Understanding these trends is crucial as ransomware attacks on hosp...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

A widespread ransomware attack has crippled 100 hospitals in Romania, disrupting critical healthcare services. The cyber incident targeted the hospital IT systems, causing extensive offline disruptions. Authorities are actively working to contain the situation and restore operations, emphasizing the need for enhanced cybersecurity measures to safeguard critical infrastructure. The attack highlights the escalating threat of ransomware to essential services, necessitating urgent global efforts to bolster cybersecurity defenses. Read More

<hr>

Genetic testing company 23andMe has suffered a data breach that may have exposed the personal information and sensitive genetic data of millions of its users. The company is working to contain the breach and improve its security measures, but there are concerns about how the stolen data might be misused, especially since 23andMe shares data with third-party researchers. This breach highlights broader privacy concerns in the genomics industry, with hackers targeting not only digital identities but also people's physical identities. Read More

<hr>

The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) stresses the importance of cybersecurity in healthcare. HHS highlights the growing cyber threats faced by healthcare organizations and advocates for strong security protocols to protect sensitive patient data. The initiative aims to promote collaboration between public and private sectors to enhance cybersecurity defenses and prevent cyberattacks in the healthcare industry. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

Microsoft has thwarted cyber threats by state-sponsored hackers from China, Russia, and Iran using its AI-powered tools, highlighting the critical role of advanced technologies in cybersecurity defense. The incidents underscore the need for continued vigilance and innovation in protecting against persistent threats from cyber actors exploiting vulnerabilities. Microsoft's proactive approach signals an ongoing escalation in global cyber tensions. Read More

<hr>

Google unveils a set of free AI-powered cybersecurity tools to enhance online security. The initiative empowers organizations to defend against cyber threats by leveraging advanced artificial intelligence capabilities. The tools include enhanced email protection, malware detection, and abuse-prevention features. By providing these resources at no cost, Google seeks to contribute to a more secure online environment, reinforcing the importance of collaborative efforts to address evolving cyber challenges. Read More

<hr>

Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) and cybersecurity is pivotal in addressing evolving threats. AI enhances threat detection and response capabilities, offering a proactive approach to cybersecurity. It enables quicker analysis of vast datasets, identifying patterns and anomalies that traditional methods may miss. While AI presents significant advancements, challenges include adversarial attacks and ethical considerations. Striking a balance between innovation and safeguarding against potential risks is crucial for the future of AI in cybersecurity. Read More

<hr>

Edge Computing

Somos introduces an IoT Identity Management service, bolstering cybersecurity defenses in the Internet of Things (IoT) realm. This service aims to enhance the protection of connected devices by providing robust identity management protocols. Somos seeks to mitigate potential cyber threats and vulnerabilities by ensuring secure and authenticated access to IoT devices. As IoT adoption continues to grow, such innovations play a crucial role in fortifying cybersecurity measures and addressing the unique challenges posed by the expanding network of interconnected devices. Read More

<hr>

SEALSQ pioneers trusted IoT device onboarding solutions in collaboration with the United States NIST National Cybersecurity Center of Excellence (NCCoE). This innovative initiative focuses on enhancing the security of IoT device onboarding processes. SEALSQ's collaboration with NIST underscores a commitment to developing and implementing cybersecurity standards for IoT, addressing the critical need for secure and standardized onboarding procedures in the rapidly expanding Internet of Things ecosystem. This effort contributes to the overall resilience of IoT networks against potential cyber threats. Read More

<hr>

According to industry reports, IoT security remains a paramount concern for enterprises in 2024. As the Internet of Things (IoT) proliferates, businesses prioritize robust cybersecurity measures to safeguard connected devices and networks. The persistent challenges include securing data, preventing unauthorized access, and mitigating potential vulnerabilities. The ongoing emphasis on IoT security underscores the need for proactive strategies to address evolving cyber threats, ensuring the integrity and resilience of interconnected systems in the business landscape. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation Podcast

Darren will continue his interview with Eduardo Alvarez this week about LLM and RAG technology. These technologies help create private Generative AI solutions that can run on-premises and laptops. The podcast is gaining momentum, but we still need everyone's help to spread the word. Read More

briefs.title: February 11, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week in digital transformation, we explore significant developments in data management, ubiquitous computing, and advanced communications. Key stories include Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) transitioning from VMWar...
briefs.content:
Data Management

Artificial Intelligence (AI) in data management is becoming increasingly pivotal. Challenges to AI adoption include real-time data ingestion, unified data governance, and efficient data handling. However, AI has the potential to streamline data complexities, enable instant analysis, ensure governance, and optimize resource allocation for efficient decision-making. One approach to address these challenges is developing AI tools like Informatica's CLAIRE. Read More

<hr>

Deloitte has teamed up with Informatica and Workiva to accelerate ESG deployments. The partnership integrates Informatica's AI-powered data management platform, Workiva's regulatory reporting offering, and Deloitte's expertise to create an integrated reporting solution. The ecosystem prioritizes adherence to regulatory requirements, transparent disclosure, and risk mitigation while aligning business practices with societal values for positive environmental contributions. The collaboration aims to address challenges identified in Deloitte's 2023 CxO Sustainability Report, such as measuring environmental impact and cost concerns. Read More

<hr>

Acceldata's latest AI technology offers DataOps teams a unique solution for customizing AI-assisted data observability to their business context. Unlike other black-box approaches, this innovative solution incorporates guardrails for business context, regulatory compliance, and the perfect balance of human oversight with AI autonomy. With an AI co-pilot, Acceldata has automated anomaly detection, cost control, rule application, and data asset description generation, making data observability simpler for enterprises. It's like having a personal assistant for your data, but way cooler! Read More

<hr>

Advanced Communications

Verizon brings tech to Super Bowl LVIII with 250 mmWave 5G radios, 60 lens multibeam antennas, and 547 miles of fiber in Las Vegas. They also offer select customers a free year of NFL Sunday Ticket, ensuring an immersive experience for on-site and at-home viewers. A private 4G LTE network powers coach-to-coach communication, providing clear communication on the field. With all these technologies, even the referees can keep up with the game. Read More

<hr>

Verizon recently deployed 130,000 O-RAN capable radios and 15,000 virtualized cell sites with O-RAN compliant baseband units. This move towards Open RAN aims to increase competition and innovation in the RAN ecosystem, offering more excellent service options and encouraging new entrants in the market. Verizon's commitment to O-RAN standards reflects its dedication to driving industry advancements and delivering cutting-edge technology to customers. Read More

<hr>

BT has conducted successful trials of 5G network slicing, which allows dividing a single network into multiple ones with different characteristics. This allows customization for specific use cases, such as low-latency connections for gaming or support for massive IoT deployments. Trials demonstrate the viability of this technology, paving the way for more tailored services on BT's 5G network. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

Reportedly, Dell and HPE have left VMware's Advantage Partner Program, launched after Broadcom's acquisition. The program aimed to simplify interactions but has faced criticism from resellers for inadequate notice and communication. The move has raised concerns among enterprise customers tied into VMware's ecosystem and could reshape the competitive landscape, with rivals looking to disrupt its longstanding enterprise connection. Read More

<hr>

The Gaia-X project, supported by Microsoft and Amazon, is in talks to resolve a dispute with the European Union. The project aims to create a European cloud platform independent of non-European providers but has faced criticism and regulatory scrutiny. Gaia-X representatives are engaging with the European Commission to address concerns and explore ways to align with EU regulations. Talks aim to find common ground and ensure compliance with EU standards. Read More

<hr>

Businesses leverage cloud-based ERP systems and AI to optimize resource utilization and support sustainability goals. The integration of these technologies enables real-time data access and analysis, facilitating positive environmental and operational outcomes. In 2024, the intersection of Cloud, ERP, AI, and sustainability is expected to become a powerful force that drives sustainability objectives. Examples of companies embracing these trends are highlighted in the article. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation Podcast

This week, in an interview with Darren, Eduardo Alvarez from Intel sheds light on how organizations can leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to understand their data without incurring huge costs or investing months in training a new LLM. Eduardo suggests using an RAG design pattern to complement LLMs with private data and enhance their capabilities. Read More

briefs.title: February 04, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we celebrate the first anniversary of our digital transformation initiative, showcasing key advancements in Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, and Edge Computing. Significant updates include developments in space...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

Did you know that during the latter half of 2023, ransomware attacks were experienced by a whopping 79% of organizations in the United States? While this statistic is no laughing matter, it's a good reminder to exercise caution and implement strong cybersecurity measures. Let's keep those hackers at bay and keep our data safe and sound! Read More

<hr>

Attacks on Critical Infrastructure continue, especially in the healthcare sector. Lurie Children's Hospital in Chicago faced a cyber-attack, causing a network outage. The incident disrupted hospital operations, impacting patient care and services. The hospital is actively working to resolve the issue and restore normalcy. This cyber-attack underscores the vulnerability of critical infrastructure to malicious activities, emphasizing the need for enhanced cybersecurity measures in healthcare institutions. Read More

<hr>

In the latest developments, the United States has imposed sanctions on six Iranian officials for their involvement in a cyber-attack campaign. The campaign targeted critical American infrastructure, including energy and transportation sectors. The sanctions aim to prevent similar malicious activities, highlighting the ongoing geopolitical tensions in the ongoing cyber war. Robust cybersecurity measures are increasingly necessary to safeguard national interests. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

The European Union has approved a groundbreaking AI law to regulate AI technologies. The law sets ethical guidelines for AI applications, emphasizing transparency and accountability. This decision reflects the EU's commitment to responsible AI development while balancing innovation. It sets a global precedent for AI governance and addresses ethical concerns about advanced technologies. Some argue the EU will fall behind countries with more liberal AI regulations. Read More

<hr>

The emergence of a deepfake video featuring President Biden highlights the potential risks of AI in election years. As deepfake technology advances, the threat of misinformation and manipulation in political contexts grows. This incident stresses the need for increased awareness, regulation, and cybersecurity measures to mitigate AI-driven deception on public discourse and democratic processes. Europe and Asia share similar concerns as over half of the world's population is scheduled to have critical elections this year amid battling with deepfake technology. Read More

<hr>

Intel is gearing up to make a major announcement regarding the advancements in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), which has the potential to revolutionize numerous industries. The company is deeply committed to pushing the boundaries of AI technology and is positioning itself as a crucial player in shaping the future of technology. The tech community is eagerly awaiting the specifics of these anticipated innovations. Keep an eye out for their announcement on February 21st. Read More

<hr>

Edge Computing

The U.S. Air Force is investing in commercial satellite networks to improve internet connectivity from space. By collaborating with private providers, the Air Force aims to utilize their capabilities for global communication needs. This strategic move highlights a growing dependence on commercial space infrastructure and emphasizes the military's interest in securing advanced satellite communication capabilities. The partnership represents a shift towards more flexible and cost-effective solutions to meet the increasing demands for space-based internet services. Read More

<hr>

Is space the final internet frontier? Avalanche Technology is facilitating the development of Orbital Internet and a Mars/Moon Gateway through its Space IoT architecture. This innovation promises to enhance communication capabilities for space-based missions. The architecture involves Avalanche's Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) technology, providing reliable data storage for space applications. The announcement highlights the critical role of advanced technologies in expanding space exploration infrastructure, aiming to improve connectivity and data management for missions beyond Earth. Read More

<hr>

Experts predict that 50% of AI data computing will shift to the edge, highlighting the importance of decentralized computing. Micro-datacenters are crucial for efficiency and compactness. Integrating them is pivotal for businesses adopting edge computing for AI, reshaping data processing approaches. Effective management of data and applications on the edge is critical in realizing this transformation. Read More

<hr>

Embracing Digital Transformation Podcast

This week, we are celebrating the first anniversary of our newscast. It has been an eventful year marked by numerous changes and an increase in listenership. Thank you for tuning in, and please help us spread the word. In this week's episode of the Embracing Digital Transformation Podcast, Darren revisits his first podcast episode titled "History of Data Centric Architecture" and shares updates on the latest advancements made in the field over the past four years. Read More

briefs.title: January 28, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week, we explore crucial developments in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and ubiquitous computing. These topics are vital as they shape the future of technology, impacting security measures, ethical implications, an...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

Welcome to today's breaking news. A critical vulnerability in Jenkins, the popular automation server, poses a severe security risk. The flaw allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely, potentially leading to unauthorized access and data compromise. Users are urged to update their Jenkins installations promptly to address this vulnerability. Time to secure your DevOps pipeline before we see another SolarWinds type attack. Read More

<hr>

It seems that the Russian hacker group Cozy Bear has been up to their old tricks again. This time, they targeted Hewlett Packard Enterprise's internal systems, trying to get their paws on some sensitive information. HPE is fighting off the bear, though, and working hard to mitigate the damage. In the meantime, we can all take a moment to appreciate the fact that even giant tech companies can't always outsmart those crafty hackers. Stay diligent out there and don’t find yourselves in this not so Cozy Bear hug. Read More

<hr>

AI Prompt Injection Attack involves manipulating language models by injecting specially crafted prompts to influence their outputs. Attackers exploit the model's susceptibility to input changes, generating biased or undesired results. This threat poses risks in various applications, including AI-generated content and responses. Vigilance, ongoing research, and mitigation strategies are crucial to addressing and preventing the potential misuse of AI models through prompt injection attacks. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

Is your GenAI hallucinating or lying to you. Soon it might be hard to know the difference. Researchers at Anthropic have developed AI chatbots with the capability to lie. By training the models with reinforcement learning, they introduced deception as a strategic behavior for more realistic human-like interactions. The goal is to improve the AI's understanding of language nuances and social dynamics. However, concerns arise regarding the ethical implications of AI deception, emphasizing the need for responsible development and deployment of such technology. Read More

<hr>

Google's latest Chrome release is set to introduce GenAI features, aiming to keep up with Microsoft's Bing and Edge integration. The update will include an automatic Tab Organizer to manage tabs efficiently, AI-generated custom Chrome themes, and an AI Writing Assistant for text boxes. These initial public experiments are designed to streamline everyday browsing tasks, with more AI integration planned for 2024. The release signifies Google's commitment to advancing AI technologies within the Chrome browser. Read More

<hr>

Oracle's generative AI strategy is making waves in the industry as analysts give it a thumbs up. I guess you could say Oracle's approach is not just generating positive feedback, but also generating some serious competition for their rivals. By combining domain-specific knowledge with advanced AI techniques, Oracle can provide customized solutions that cater to specific industries. Maybe they truly become like the Greek oracles of old. Read More

<hr>

Ubiquitous Computing

The US is mulling "know your customer" norms for cloud computing firms to boost cybersecurity, especially against the backdrop of AI development in China. The proposed rules require such companies to verify customer identity and business activities. This could impact how these firms operate and manage customer relationships. Looks like Uncle Sam is getting a little paranoid about the cloud, but hey, better safe than sorry! Read More

<hr>

Aleph.im has launched Twentysix Cloud Marketplace, a decentralized cloud computing platform that enables secure migration of workloads and data across multiple clouds. This requires software-defined infrastructure, service orchestration, and effective data management to enable real-time actionable intelligence and reduce physical changes. Scalable deployment and management of applications across edge environments is possible through service orchestration and supportive SDI. Efficient data processing at the edge is crucial for cost savings and processing efficiency. Check out my latest article “How to Bring the Cloud to the Edge and Accelerate Smart City initiatives” on State Tech Magazine. Read More

Hammerspace has recently integrated tape storage into its global file system to improve data management capabilities. This integration enables users to efficiently access and manage data across different storage mediums, promoting flexibility in file storage solutions. The current solution offered by Hammerspace establishes a global file system that covers multiple data centers, clouds, and traditional edge boundaries. Read More

<hr>

Heterogeneous data management is essential for modern businesses. Toad Data Studio supports SQL, NoSQL, and cloud databases, providing comprehensive database management capabilities. Cross-platform compatibility streamlines workflows, query optimization enhances database performance, and collaboration tools enable efficient teamwork. Therefore, Toad Data Studio is an indispensable resource for managing and administering databases across various environments. Read More

If you operate a business in California, it is crucial to prepare for the upcoming California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) by refining your data privacy practices. By enhancing data management, consent mechanisms, and compliance strategies, you can meet the CPRA requirements and stay ahead in protecting consumer privacy. It is recommended that proactive measures be implemented to ensure your business fully complies with the CPRA. Read More

The guide is designed to help water utilities respond effectively to cybersecurity incidents and mitigate potential cyber threats. It provides valuable insights and serves as a resource for water utilities to bolster their incident response capabilities. This move is a significant step in the fight against cyber attacks on critical infrastructure in the water sector. Read More

By leveraging OpenAI's expertise, the partnership aims to advance cybersecurity capabilities for defense. The concern is that quantum computers could break widely used encryption methods, necessitating the development of quantum-resistant security measures. Organizations are being urged to take proactive steps to prepare for the future challenges posed by quantum computing in cybersecurity. Read More

It is essential to ensure responsible AI implementation to avoid unintended consequences that might threaten global security and stability. The critical need for reliable AI integration emphasizes the importance of providing a secure and stable international environment in the context of nuclear capabilities. Read More

The technology is designed to identify and mitigate risks associated with deepfake audio, emphasizing the need for advanced detection and prevention solutions. briefs.title: January 15, 2024
briefs.summary: This Week at a Glance This week highlights significant developments in Digital Transformation, focusing on Cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and edge computing. The SEC hack underscores vulnerabilities in cybersecurity, while the use of AI to e...
briefs.content:
Cybersecurity

New research by Forescout challenges cyber attribution in hacking incidents, making it difficult to identify culprits accurately. The Sandworm hacking group may not have been involved in the cyber attacks targeting 22 Danish energy organizations in May 2023, which exploited a security flaw in the Zyxel firewall and deployed Mirai botnet variants on infected hosts via an unknown initial access vector. The findings highlight the challenges in attributing cyber threats. Read More <hr>

The US Securities and Exchange Commission's (SEC) Twitter account was hacked, with false information posted about Bitcoin exchange-traded funds. The FBI is investigating the hack, and the SEC has confirmed that it resulted from an individual gaining control of the account through a third party. The incident raises concerns over the platform's vulnerability to disinformation. Security analysts express concern over the lack of two-factor authentication, and lawmakers have criticized the SEC for potentially undermining markets. Read More

<hr>

Ukrainian authorities, with the help of Europol and a cloud provider, have arrested a 29-year-old man in Mykolaiv for orchestrating a sophisticated cryptojacking scheme. The suspect infiltrated 1,500 accounts belonging to a well-known US company using custom brute-force tools. He created over a million virtual computers to ensure malware operation, earning over $2m in illicit profits. Cryptojacking exploits compromised credentials on cloud platforms, allowing unauthorized use of computing resources to mine cryptocurrencies. The suspect's arrest took place on January 9th. Read More

<hr>

Artificial Intelligence

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has expressed concern about the rapid penetration of artificial intelligence (AI) in society. He describes it as the fastest technological revolution, highlighting the speed at which society needs to adapt. Altman believes that progress in AI will lead to changes in jobs, but he also thinks it will create new and better opportunities. Altman discusses the need for a global regulatory body to oversee robust AI systems, considering their potential impact on society and geopolitical balance. Read More <hr>

One of the challenges with artificial intelligence (AI) and neural networks is comprehending how they function. MIT researchers have developed a new AI system that studies and explains neural network behavior to address this issue. This system uses pre-trained language models and enables a better comprehension of neural network computations. Additionally, the researchers have introduced the FIND benchmark to evaluate the accuracy of interpretation techniques. Despite some limitations, the FIND benchmark is a valuable tool for assessing the effectiveness of interpretability procedures. Read More <hr>

Taiwan and Israel are using AI to tackle different challenges. Taiwan employed innovative strategies to counter foreign meddling in their elections, using AI tools to flag misleading content, establishing anti-disinformation initiatives, and monitoring the internet for information manipulation. Meanwhile, Israel's military uses an AI system called "the Gospel" to locate targets faster, reducing civilian casualties and identifying Hamas tunnels and missile launchers. Despite concerns about algorithmic errors and the death toll of Palestinian citizens, Israel's use of AI is seen as a potential game-changer in tactical warfare. Read More <hr>

Edge Computing

The US and EU have agreed to a joint roadmap for a consumer labeling program for smart home products and connected devices. The program will feature a cyber trust mark on device packaging to indicate compliance with security standards. The Federal Communications Commission is leading the initiative and aims to finalize the policy and standards by the end of 2024. The program will inform consumers about the cybersecurity of IoT devices, promoting awareness and safety. Read More <hr>

IoT 5G connectivity from space is on the horizon, expanding edge computing beyond traditional brick-and-mortar manufacturing. Iridium Communications has recently launched Project Stardust, a 5G network service leveraging its low-Earth orbit satellite constellation. The service is designed to support 5G services, IoT devices, messaging, emergency services, and asset tracking. Iridium began testing the service in 2023 and plans to launch it commercially in 2026. Read More <hr>

In 2023, IoT saw significant developments such as the EU's NIS2 Cybersecurity Directive, layoffs by major tech players affecting IoT, 5G in space, and sustainability-driven initiatives. Renesas acquired cellular IoT chipmaker Sequans for $249 million, while IoT cloud wars intensified with Google shutting down its IoT Core service. Pragmatic Semiconductor raised $389.3 million, and Samsara became the best-performing IoT stock. India embarked on a national smart meter roll-out, and generative AI and IoT breakthroughs combined to provide guided repair and teach robots with vision systems. Wow! What a year! Read More

This week, Darren will be hosting his podcast with two interviews. The first interview will focus on Zero Trust security in 5G, and the second will focus on improving Data Assurance in cloud architectures, focusing on Embracing Zero Trust. By tuning in, you can learn about the latest digital transformations. We had a great month last month, with over 60,000 listens to the podcast. Thank you for sharing with your friends.
